guide: [[@2611.34776|DFly2]] 说明原生稀疏模型做投机解码时，草稿模型应该直接借用目标模型选好的位置，不要另建缓存；但长 prompt 下大部分时间花在 prefill，端到端只快 1.5 倍左右，看数字时要分清解码加速和端到端加速。[[@2611.33542|RankCast]] 在长上下文 MoE 服务里比 EPLB 有效，因为按历史负载摆放专家跟不上每批的变化；代价是改了路由，精度不是无损的。[[@2611.34615|PipeAxes]] 最有价值的是那段测量：MoE 上把 chunk 调小几乎碰不到更少的专家，**调小块大小换 decode 延迟的老办法走不通**；标题里的倍数则来自很小的样本。

[[@2611.33981|MixMoMo]] 在手机 SoC 上把超大 MoE 拆到 GPU 和 NPU 上，用混合精度跑，解码比统一 Q4_0 量化快 3.72 倍。[[@2611.34010|非对称投机解码]]只给草稿模型看示例解答、不改目标模型的 prompt，免训练拿到 2.29–4.95 倍加速。[[@2611.33896|Floodgates]] 让循环结构的语言模型用掩码 token 后缀并行起草，自投机解码最高快 7.5 倍。[[@2611.33761|ScanAR]] 把统一自回归模型生成图像时的解码深度从 H×W 降到 H+W，Emu3.5-Image-34B 出 512×512 的图快 13.8 倍。[[@2611.34273|Libtt]] 给 Tenstorrent 处理器实现了 PJRT 接口，JAX 和 PyTorch 可以直接跑在这类非 NVIDIA 硬件上。

papers.title: DFly2: Turbocharging Long-Context Speculative Decoding by Sharing the Target's Sparsity
papers.title_zh: 草稿模型直接用目标的稀疏选择，64K 长上下文吞吐高 81%
papers.summary_zh: 让草稿模型复用目标模型的KV与稀疏索引，加速长上下文投机解码
papers.abstract_zh: 为避免稠密注意力在长上下文上的二次方开销，DeepSeek-V4、Hy4 等模型已转向原生稀疏；投机解码在解码最慢的场景最有价值，也越来越多地运行在这类模型上。然而，它们的草稿模型仍保留自己的上下文缓存，覆盖整个提示或一个滑动窗口。除了显存，这种缓存还会拖累 prefill 时间、前缀缓存命中和解码并发度。读取目标模型缓存的草稿模型省去了自己的缓存，但只决定了读哪份缓存，没有决定读哪些位置，仍然读取全部位置或最近的窗口。这两种规则都不是为当前 query 设计的，而在草稿模型里为每个 query 单独计算选择，代价又会随上下文增长。可原生稀疏的目标模型本来就会在它必须维护的缓存上，为每个 query 挑选位置。因此，草稿模型的两项选择——用哪份缓存、读哪些位置——目标模型都已做出并付过代价。我们测量了一次选择能沿用多远：在 DS-V4.1-Flash 上，提前一步做出的选择仍能覆盖后续每个 token 所选内容的近九成。我们提出 DFly2，一个共享目标模型稀疏性的块并行草稿模型。每个草稿层读取与之配对的目标层所缓存的 KV（==KV 共享==），位置取该层 indexer 选出的、可来自上下文任意处的固定数量位置（==Index 共享==）。因此 DFly2 不做打分，也不保留自己的缓存。在 DS-V4.1-Flash、GLM-5.3-Flash 和 Hy4 flash 这三个稀疏注意力与架构各不相同的模型上，在通用、长上下文和智能体基准中，它每步接受的 token 数都多于用相同配方训练的 DFlash 和 DSpark。相对更强基线的优势从通用负载上的 3.9%–10.5% 扩大到长上下文和智能体负载上的 10.0%–31.5%。在 DS-V4.1-Flash 的高并发场景下，单用户解码速度相同时，**它在两个 64K 数据集上的吞吐分别高出 62% 和 81%**。
papers.abstract_en: To avoid the quadratic cost of dense attention over long contexts, models such as DeepSeek-V4 and Hy4 have turned natively sparse, and speculative decoding, which matters most where decoding is slowest, increasingly runs on them. Their drafters, however, still keep a context cache of their own, over the whole prompt or a sliding window. Beyond memory, such a cache costs prefill time, prefix-cache hits and decode concurrency. Drafters that read the target's cache avoid one of their own, but settle only which cache, not which positions, and still read everything or a recent window. Neither rule is made for the query at hand, and computing a selection per query in the drafter would cost more as the context grows. Yet a natively sparse target already picks positions for each query, over a cache it keeps anyway. Both of the drafter's choices are therefore already made, and paid for, by the target: its cache and its selection. We measure how far one selection carries: made a step early, it still covers close to nine tenths of what each later token selects on DS-V4.1-Flash. We present DFly2, a block-parallel drafter that shares the target's sparsity. Each draft layer reads the KV its paired target layer cached (KV sharing), at the positions that layer's indexer selected, a fixed number anywhere in the context (Index sharing). DFly2 thus runs no scoring pass and keeps no cache of its own. On DS-V4.1-Flash, GLM-5.3-Flash and Hy4~flash, whose sparse attention and architecture differ, it accepts more tokens per step than DFlash and DSpark trained on the same recipe, over general, long-context and agentic benchmarks. Its margin over the stronger baseline widens from 3.9%-10.5% on general workloads to 10.0%-31.5% on long-context and agentic ones. At high concurrency on DS-V4.1-Flash, at matched per-user decode speed, its throughput is 62% and 81% higher on two 64K sets.
analysis: 原生稀疏的大模型（DeepSeek-V4 一类）本来就会为每个 query 挑出要看的位置，所以[[speculative-decoding|投机解码]]的草稿模型不必再自建上下文缓存。DFly2 直接读目标模型的 KV 缓存和选择结果，在 DS-V4.1-Flash 上、单用户解码速度相同时，**两个 64K 数据集的吞吐比 DSpark 高 62% 和 81%**，短文本高 28%。前提是锚点前一步的选择对块内后续 5 个草稿位仍适用：在 15.9 万个块上平均覆盖率约 0.88，同样大小的最近窗口不到 0.18。

草稿模型有 3 层，每层对应目标模型的一个 DSA 层（带 indexer 打分选位置的稀疏注意力层）。==KV 共享==：直接读该层已缓存的 latent；==Index 共享==：只读该层 indexer 在锚点前一行选出的 top-512 个位置，再加 128 个近邻，每步共读 646 个位置，与上下文长短无关。草稿层的权重和专家都从对应层复制。另外补了两样缓存里没有的东西：目标最后一层的 hidden，以及读上下文的==块内修正==。自建缓存不只占显存：[[pd-disaggregation|PD 分离]]部署下草稿模型还得跑在 prefill 实例上。在 DS-V4.1-Flash 上，自建缓存让每 token 的 KV 增加 76%，去掉后 32K 下能多容纳 1.73 倍的并发请求。

消融实验说明，接受长度的提升主要来自共享选择，省掉缓存的贡献不大。去掉 top-k、只留近邻窗口，长上下文的[[acceptance-length|接受长度]] τ 从 3.62 降到 2.76；换回草稿模型自建的缓存只降到 3.34。长度外推的差异更明显：草稿模型都只训练到 32K，在 Hy4 flash 上超过这个长度后，全缓存的 DFlash 只剩每步 1.08 个 token，DFly2 在 agent 任务上的接受长度与通用任务的平均值相差不到 4%。

保留意见：**长 prompt 下端到端收益远小于解码收益**。DS-V4.1-Flash 的 agent 组端到端加速是 1.50 倍，DSpark 是 1.44 倍，长 prompt 的时间主要花在 prefill；基线也都是作者按同一配方重训的，没有和模型自带的 MTP 模块比，硬件只有 H20。对用稀疏模型做长上下文或 agent 服务的团队来说，草稿模型应该优先接入目标的 indexer 和 KV，不要另建缓存；在 vLLM 里它不需要单独注册 KV group。
star_reasons: 核心推理服务问题：长上下文投机解码里草稿模型的缓存和读取位置
在三个架构不同的原生稀疏模型上实测（H20、vLLM、PD 分离），基线用同一配方训练
高并发下 64K 吞吐高 62%/81%，草稿模型还不占 KV 并发和 prefill

figures.caption_zh: 左图看蓝线和灰线的差距：锚点前一步的 ==top-512 选择==对块内后续 token 的覆盖率约 0.88，同样大小的最近窗口只有 0.15–0.18；右图显示上下文越长，两者差距越大。
DFlash、DSpark 把上下文投影成自己的 KV 再存起来，DFly2 只在运行时接收目标层的 latent KV 和 top-k 下标，自己不带 indexer。DS-V4.1-Flash 上每步固定读 646 个位置。
DS-V4.1-Flash 的吞吐与单用户解码速度曲线，越靠右上越好。看虚线：单用户速度相同时，DFly2 比 DSpark 吞吐高 28%（短文本）、62%（CodeSpan 64K）和 **81%（SWE 64K）**。
32K 下的最大并发：草稿模型自建全缓存记为 1×。DS-V4.1-Flash 本身 KV 压得最小，去掉草稿缓存后并发提高到 1.73×；短窗口要缩到 128 才接近这个数。
三个目标模型、七个长上下文和 agent 基准上的接受长度和解码加速（单请求、贪心解码），色块标出 DFly2 相对更强基线的提升。
整体结构：3 个草稿层各对应一个目标 DSA 层，读该层的 KV 和 indexer 选择；目标最后一层的 hidden 经门控注入锚点位置，块内修正逐位置重读上下文。

papers.title: RankCast: Phase-Aware Rank Balancing in MoE Serving
papers.title_zh: 不搬专家只改次要路由，MoE prefill 吞吐最高涨 19%
papers.affiliation: 美团；伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳-香槟分校（UIUC）
papers.summary_zh: 在预填充与解码阶段分别降低 EP rank 的最大 token 数和激活专家数。
papers.abstract_zh: 现代大语言模型（LLM）推理越来越多地采用将预填充（P）与解码（D）阶段分离的解耦架构。同时，专家并行（EP）已被广泛用于大规模混合专家（MoE）模型服务。然而，负载不均衡仍会拖慢 MoE 推理，因为每一层都必须等待最繁忙的 EP rank。预填充与解码的主要延迟来源不同：预填充是计算受限的，其 MoE 层延迟由最繁忙 rank 的最大 token 数决定；而在中等批大小下，解码是访存受限的，延迟由各 rank 中最多的激活专家数主导。为在统一框架下同时解决这两个问题，我们提出 ==RankCast==，一个在预填充阶段降低 rank 级最大 token 数、在解码阶段降低最大激活专家数的系统。对每个 token，RankCast 保留预测的 ==Top-p 专家==，并从其 Top-L 候选（L > k）中选出其余 k−p 个。在预填充中，RankCast 为每个 rank 给出一个价格，引导可调整的分配流向负载较轻的 rank；在解码中，RankCast 关闭最繁忙 rank 上的专家，同时满足每个 token 的约束。两条路径均在业界领先的推理框架 SGLang 和 DeepEP 中实现并测试。我们让 RankCast 的 kernel 与模型执行重叠，并复用 DeepEP 现有的通信通道传输元数据。在 EP=8 的 Qwen3-235B-A22B 和 EP=16 的 Qwen3.5-397B-A17B 上，RankCast 消除了最繁忙 rank 超出均值部分的 75% 以上，**预填充输入吞吐最高提升 19%，解码每输出 token 时间最高降低 10%**，质量损失低于一个百分点。
papers.abstract_en: Modern large language model (LLM) inference increasingly adopts disaggregated architectures that separate Prefill (P) and Decode (D) phases. Meanwhile, Expert Parallelism (EP) has been widely adopted in large Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model serving. However, load imbalance still slows down MoE inference because each layer must wait for the busiest EP rank. The main source of latency differs between prefill and decode. Prefill is compute-bound, and its MoE layers' latency is determined by the maximum token count of the busiest rank. At the same time, under moderate batch sizes, Decode is memory-bound, so the latency is dominated by the maximum active-expert count across ranks. To solve both problems under a unified framework, we present RankCast, a system that reduces rank-level maximum token counts during prefill and active-expert counts during decode. For every token, RankCast preserves the predicted Top-p experts and chooses the remaining k-p from its Top-L candidates (L > k). In prefill, RankCast yields a price per rank that steers flexible assignments to less loaded ranks. In decode, RankCast closes experts on the busiest ranks while preserving the constraints for each token. Both paths are implemented and tested in the state-of-the-art inference frameworks SGLang and DeepEP. We overlap RankCast's kernels with model execution and reuse the existing DeepEP communication channel for metadata transmission. On Qwen3-235B-A22B with EP=8 and Qwen3.5-397B-A17B with EP=16, RankCast removes over 75% of the busiest rank's excess prefill load, improves prefill input throughput by up to 19%, and reduces decode time per output token by up to 10%. The quality cost is below one percentage point.
analysis: 在 [[expert-parallelism|专家并行（EP）]] 的 MoE 推理里，每一层都要等最忙的那个 rank（一张 GPU）算完。RankCast 的办法是不复制、不搬动专家权重，而是在推理时调整每个 token 排名靠后的专家选择。在 [[pd-disaggregation|PD 分离]] 部署的 Qwen3-235B（8 卡 EP）上，**prefill 输入吞吐提升 16–19%，比 DeepSeek 的在线 [[eplb|EPLB]] 多 2.7–6.8 个点**；decode 的每输出 token 时间（TPOT）降低 6–8%，在 Qwen3.5-397B 上降低 9–11%。

论文先用 profiling 说明两个阶段的瓶颈不同：prefill 的专家 GEMM 时间随 rank 收到的 token 数线性增长；decode 时耗时花在读权重上，每多激活一个专家多 9.5 µs。两条路径共用一个约束：每个 token 保留预测的 ==Top-p 保护专家==（p=2），其余 k−p 个只能在 Top-L（L=16）候选里换，仍然跑满 k 个专家。prefill 给每个 rank 算一个==价格==，从候选分数里减掉，拥挤的 rank 就少接 token；decode 则在最忙的 rank 上==关闭专家==。下一层的路由用当前层的 hidden state 乘下一层门控权重来预测，元数据搭 DeepEP 已有的 dispatch 消息传输，额外开销 0.5–0.9%。

最值得记住的是长上下文场景。在 LongBench v2 的 32K 输入上，EPLB 和加了 8 个冗余专家的 EPLB-R 吞吐变化只有 −1.2% 到 +0.9%，RankCast 仍有 +4–7%。原因是每批负载分布都在变，按历史负载摆放专家跟不上；把每批价格换成跨批累积的慢偏置，收益同样归零。**冗余专家占用 HBM、挤掉并发请求，在两个模型上都比不加冗余的 EPLB 更慢。**decode 端，TPOT 和最忙 rank 的激活专家数呈线性关系（每个专家 0.52 ms，R²=0.99），RankCast 把这个数从 14.4 降到 9.7。

**它改了模型的路由，所以不是无损的**：8 个基准里最大掉 0.85 个百分点，作者说在重复运行的波动范围内，但 MMLU-Redux 等 4 个基准只跑了 3 次。我觉得更大的缺口在 decode 对比：XShare、OEA 只在离线回放里比较，没有放进同一个服务栈跑端到端；此外只测了 Qwen 一个模型家族、最多 16 张 H800，DeepSeek 系的 sigmoid 门控没有测。对用 SGLang + DeepEP 跑 MoE、长上下文 prefill 显存紧张的团队，这条路比加冗余专家更划算；它和 EPLB 理论上可以叠加，但论文没测。
star_reasons: 核心 AI Infra 问题：EP 下 MoE 推理的 rank 级负载不均，prefill 和 decode 分别建模
真实规模：16 张 H800、SGLang + DeepEP 端到端实测，对比主流的在线 EPLB 及冗余专家
长上下文下 EPLB 几乎无效（−1.2% 到 +0.9%），RankCast 仍有 +4–7%，说明按历史负载放置专家跟不上逐批变化
质量代价逐项报告，并给出与重复运行波动的对比

左图：Qwen3-235B 的 decode TPOT 与最忙 rank 激活专家数在 11 种配置下几乎成一条直线（每个专家 0.52 ms，R²=0.99），截距 20.1 ms 是关专家省不掉的部分。右图：跨层路由预测的准确率，真实 Top-8 有 98.7% 落在预测的 Top-16 里。

papers.title: PipeAxes: Decoupling Compute and Communication Granularities for Pipeline-Parallel LLM Serving
papers.title_zh: 按层而非按 token 切 prefill，PCIe 双卡上短请求首 token 快 250 倍
papers.summary_zh: 分层切片宽 prefill 并压缩激活传输，在 PCIe 与异构 GPU 上做长上下文流水线服务。
papers.abstract_zh: 流水线并行可以在 PCIe 服务器和异构 GPU 集群上服务长上下文语言模型。现有引擎把 prefill 切成 token 块，以减少 decode 停顿；但块大小同时决定了 GPU 批宽度和阶段间激活传输的大小：小块会更频繁地重新加载模型权重，大块则可能长时间占满 GPU 和链路，拖慢交互式请求。==PipeAxes== 运行宽 prefill 批，但每次只推进几层，使 decode 能在切片之间运行。一个融合的 Triton Hadamard-INT4 编解码器压缩激活，压缩后的激活按各自大小独立的行组，通过多条并行 TCP 连接传输。调度器根据延迟余量选择批宽度、切片深度和行组大小。我们在 A800、RTX 4090 和 RTX 3090 GPU 上做了 97 次回放、覆盖 5,016 个请求。**在链路带宽变化十倍期间，全部 74 个请求都满足了延迟目标。**在四阶段混合专家（MoE）流水线中，PipeAxes 在满足延迟目标的前提下，可服务的请求速率是校准后 Revisit-PP 的 23.3 倍、带 Express 的 Fixed-4096 的 4.44 倍。在混合 64K 上下文负载中，**短请求的 p95 首 token 时间从原生 vLLM 的 129.8 秒降到 512 毫秒。**使用 INT4 传输时，相对 BF16，MMLU 准确率提高 0.06 个百分点，GSM8K 准确率下降 0.46 个百分点。
papers.abstract_en: Pipeline parallelism can serve long-context language models on PCIe servers and across heterogeneous GPU clusters. Existing engines split prefill into token chunks to limit decode stalls. The chunk size also sets the GPU batch width and the size of activation transfers between stages. Small chunks reload model weights more often. Large chunks can keep the GPU and the link busy long enough to delay interactive requests. PipeAxes runs wide prefill batches a few layers at a time so decodes can run between slices. A fused Triton Hadamard-INT4 codec compresses activations, which travel in independently sized row groups over parallel TCP sockets. The scheduler uses latency slack to choose batch width, slice depth, and row-group size. We evaluated PipeAxes in 97 replays covering 5,016 requests on A800, RTX 4090, and RTX 3090 GPUs. All 74 requests met their latency targets during a tenfold bandwidth swing. In a four-stage mixture-of-experts pipeline, PipeAxes served requests within their latency targets at 23.3x the rate of calibrated Revisit-PP and 4.44x the rate of Fixed-4096 with Express. In a mixed 64K-context workload, p95 time to first token for short requests fell from 129.8 s with native vLLM to 512 ms. With INT4 transport, MMLU accuracy rose by 0.06 percentage points and GSM8K accuracy fell by 0.46 percentage points relative to BF16.
analysis: 在 PCIe 或以太网相连的 GPU 上做==流水线并行==（PP，按层把模型切到几张卡上）服务时，[[chunked-prefill]] 的块大小一个参数同时决定了 GPU 批宽度、decode 要等多久、级间要传多少数据，调小调大都吃亏。PipeAxes 把这三个粒度拆开：在 64K 混合长上下文负载下，短请求 p95 首 token 时间（TTFT）从原生 vLLM 的 129.8 秒降到 512 毫秒；四级 MoE 流水线上，[[slo-goodput|SLO goodput]] 是 Revisit-PP（OSDI'26 的 PP 服务调度方案）的 23.3 倍。

做法分三块。==LayerSpool== 让 prefill 保持宽批（本地最大 4096 token），每次只推进几层就把 GPU 让给 decode，每层权重每批只加载一次。级间激活先把 hidden state 和 residual 相加（下一层本来只用它们的和），再做 [[hadamard-rotation|Hadamard 旋转]]和 INT4 打包，一个融合的 Triton kernel 小批量下只要 0.10 ms，传输量降到 1/7.53。压缩后的激活按==行组==轮流走多条 TCP 连接，短请求和 decode 可以在每个 32 KiB 帧的边界插队。调度器根据离延迟目标还剩多少余量，选批宽、切片层数和行组大小。实现基于 vLLM v0.23.0，改动和新增约 4,100 行。

最值得记住的是第 2 节的测量：Qwen3-30B-A3B 上，128 token 以上的块就几乎会碰到全部 128 个专家，块从 4096 缩到 128，一个 stage 的计算时间增加 591.7%。**所以在 MoE 上，靠调小 chunk 换 decode 延迟这条常规办法基本走不通。**另一面，收益主要在延迟而不是吞吐：两张 4090 单机上，PipeAxes 的输出吞吐只有原生 vLLM 的 95.3%，goodput 比“固定 512 块 + 同样的插队通道”只高 1.23 倍，可见单机场景里不少收益来自插队通道本身。

保留意见：**最惊人的倍数来自很小的样本**，23.3 倍是 21 个请求里 16 个对 1 个达标，64K 场景总共 23 个请求；Revisit-PP 是作者从 SGLang 移植到 vLLM 的版本；实验只有 Qwen3、最多 4 级，关闭了前缀缓存，代码要到发表后才开源。对用消费级卡或跨机房链路跑长上下文 PP 的团队，“prefill 按层让出 GPU”和“级间激活 INT4 压缩”可以直接借鉴；有 NVLink 的机内部署论文没有测。
star_reasons: 核心推理服务问题：PP 下 chunked prefill 的块大小同时绑定计算、等待和传输三个粒度
真实硬件测量：A800、4090、3090 上 97 次回放，基线是同一 vLLM v0.23.0 引擎和 OSDI'26 的 Revisit-PP
实测发现：MoE 上把 chunk 调小会让 stage 计算时间多出近 6 倍，改变了“调小 chunk 换延迟”的常规做法

papers.title: MixMoMo: Accelerating Extra--Large MoE Inference with Mixed--Precision GPU--NPU Execution on Mobile Devices
papers.title_zh: MixMoMo：在移动设备上以混合精度GPU-NPU执行加速超大MoE推理
papers.summary_zh: 面向移动SoC的混合精度MoE推理运行时，解码速度比统一Q4_0快3.72倍。
papers.abstract_zh: 移动智能体和端侧智能越来越需要在智能手机上运行更强大的模型。混合专家（MoE）通过稀疏的专家激活扩展模型容量，但日益增多的细粒度专家使加载和计算变得复杂。模型压缩与专家卸载相辅相成，可降低存储和计算成本。在压缩技术中，混合精度量化为各专家分配较低的位宽，以平衡模型质量与推理效率。然而，现有的离线指标和路由分数无法反映专家的量化敏感度，削弱了精度分配的效果。多样的位宽还使具有不同执行特性的GPU与NPU之间难以均衡分配专家，而逐tile反量化又使NPU的向量并行性利用不足。我们提出MixMoMo，一个面向异构移动SoC上超大MoE模型的高效混合精度推理运行时。MixMoMo将离线量化影响画像与基于激活的运行时风险估计结合，实现质量约束下的专家位宽分配；进一步采用==精度结构化执行==在GPU与NPU间均衡分配专家，并采用HVX并行反量化来高效利用NPU向量单元。在两个移动平台、三个MoE模型和五个基准上，MixMoMo的平均解码速度**比统一Q4_0快3.72倍，比最强的混合精度MoE基线快1.53倍**。
papers.abstract_en: Mobile agents and on-device intelligence increasingly demand more capable models on smartphones. Through sparse expert activation, Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) scales model capacity, yet growing numbers of fine-grained experts complicate loading and computation. Model compression complements expert offloading by reducing storage and computation costs. Among compression techniques, mixed-precision quantization assigns lower expert bitwidths to balance model quality and inference efficiency. However, existing offline metrics and routing scores fail to reflect expert quantization sensitivity, undermining precision assignment. Diverse bitwidths also complicate balanced expert allocation across GPUs and NPUs with distinct execution characteristics, while tile-wise dequantization underutilizes NPU vector parallelism. We present MixMoMo, an efficient mixed-precision inference runtime for extra-large MoE models on heterogeneous mobile SoCs. MixMoMo combines offline quantization-impact profiles with activation-based runtime risk estimates for quality-constrained expert bitwidth assignment. It further adopts precision-structured execution for balanced GPU-NPU expert allocation and HVX-parallel dequantization for efficient NPU vector utilization. Across three MoE models and five benchmarks on two mobile platforms, MixMoMo achieves average decoding speedups of 3.72x over uniform Q4_0 and 1.53x over the strongest mixed-precision MoE baseline.

papers.title: Improving Tail-Augmented Speculative Drafting with Hidden State Mixing and Gradient Detach
papers.title_zh: 通过隐状态混合与梯度截断改进尾部增强的投机草稿生成
papers.summary_zh: 提出两种仅训练期方法提升MTP/EAGLE草稿器的接受长度，并开源于Megatron-LM。
papers.abstract_zh: 多token预测（MTP）模块和EAGLE风格的草稿器通过复用目标模型的隐状态来支持高效的投机解码。然而，它们的自回归使用带来训练与推理的不匹配：训练时提供的是来自主干或单步MTP的隐状态序列，而推理时则要关注目标模型前缀以及后面不断增长的、循环生成的MTP状态尾部。EAGLE-3的训练时测试（TTT）在训练中显式模拟这一行为，代价是额外的内存和专门的注意力掩码。我们提出两种仅用于训练的方法来改进自回归草稿生成。==隐状态混合==（HSM）在对齐到同一预测目标的主干与MTP隐状态之间采样，使草稿器接触来自不同MTP步的状态混合，而无需显式模拟推理。==隐状态梯度截断==（HSGD）是一种正则化方法，在保留前向计算的同时随机阻断经过隐状态和嵌入通路的梯度。两种方法都不增加推理开销。在联合预训练加监督微调中，HSGD在早期草稿位置取得最高接受率，HSM在后期草稿位置表现最好。这些接受率趋势表明HSM适合长草稿长度的服务，HSGD适合短草稿长度的服务。此外，在四个Nemotron模型和DeepSeek-V4-Pro上，冻结主干的基于HSM的MTP增强将平均接受长度比联合训练的MTP**提升最多52.2%**。对于EAGLE-3草稿器，HSM的接受率与TTT相当，在四步Qwen3-8B对比中**峰值预留训练内存降低48%**。HSM的实现已在Megatron-LM和NVIDIA Model Optimizer中公开。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-token prediction (MTP) modules and EAGLE-style drafters support efficient speculative decoding by reusing target-model hidden states. Their autoregressive use, however, introduces a training-inference mismatch: training supplies sequences of hidden states from the backbone or a single MTP step, whereas inference attends to a target-model prefix followed by a growing tail of recurrently generated MTP states. EAGLE-3's training-time test (TTT) explicitly simulates this behavior during training, at the cost of additional memory and specialized attention masks. We introduce two training-only methods for improving autoregressive drafting. Hidden State Mixing (HSM) samples among backbone and MTP hidden states aligned to the same prediction target, exposing the drafter to mixtures of states from different MTP steps without explicitly simulating inference. Hidden State Gradient Detach (HSGD) is a regularization method that stochastically blocks gradients through hidden state and embedding pathways while preserving the forward computation. Neither method adds inference cost. In joint pretraining followed by supervised fine-tuning, HSGD yields the highest acceptance rates at early draft positions, while HSM performs best later in the draft. These acceptance rate trends favor HSM for long-draft-length serving and HSGD for short-draft-length serving. Furthermore, across four Nemotron models and DeepSeek-V4-Pro, HSM-based MTP boosting with a frozen backbone improves mean acceptance length by up to 52.2% over the co-trained MTP. For EAGLE-3 drafters, HSM offers competitive acceptance with TTT, with 48% lower peak reserved training memory in a four-step Qwen3-8B comparison. HSM implementations are publicly available in Megatron-LM and NVIDIA Model Optimizer.

papers.title: Asymmetric Speculative Decoding: Unlocking In-Context Learning in Draft Models
papers.title_zh: 非对称投机解码：释放草稿模型的上下文学习能力
papers.summary_zh: 给草稿模型提供示例解答而不改目标模型提示，免训练获得2.29至4.95倍加速。
papers.abstract_zh: 投机解码先起草、再并行验证，以降低大语言模型（LLM）的推理延迟。然而实际加速远低于理论上限，在推理任务上尤其如此。我们将根本原因归结为==任务同构==：现有方法给两个模型提供相同的提示，迫使草稿模型去解决超出其能力的问题，造成很高的拒绝率，抵消了并行带来的收益。我们发现接受率在生成过程中单调上升，这揭示了一种潜在的上下文学习（ICL）效应：草稿模型通过从已验证的token中学习，逐步与目标分布对齐。改变上下文窗口大小的对照实验证实，这一提升源于ICL驱动的对齐，而非token难度。受此启发，我们提出非对称投机解码（AsymSpec），一个免训练框架，将提供给草稿模型和目标模型的提示解耦。通过向草稿模型提供与任务相关的示例解答，我们把它的目标从推理重新表述为模拟，从第一个token起就放大ICL效应。我们证明AsymSpec产生精确样本，并以指数速度收敛到目标分布。在推理、代码生成和摘要任务上，AsymSpec相比自回归解码实现**2.29倍至4.95倍的加速**，无需重新训练模型即超过标准投机解码。
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding addresses Large Language Model (LLM) inference latency by first drafting and then verifying in parallel. Yet practical speedups fall far short of theoretical bounds, especially on reasoning tasks. We identify the root cause as task isomorphism: existing methods provide identical prompts to both models, forcing the draft model to solve problems beyond its capacity. This produces high rejection rates that eliminate parallelization gains. We discover that acceptance rates increase monotonically during generation, revealing a latent in-context learning (ICL) effect wherein the draft model progressively aligns with the target distribution by learning from verified tokens. Controlled experiments with varying context window sizes confirm this improvement stems from ICL-driven alignment rather than token difficulty. Motivated by this finding, we propose Asymmetric Speculative Decoding (AsymSpec), a training-free framework that decouples the prompts provided to draft and target models. By supplying the draft model with task-relevant example solutions, we reformulate its objective from reasoning to simulation, amplifying the ICL effect from the first token. We prove AsymSpec produces exact samples and converges exponentially to the target distribution. Across reasoning, code generation, and summarization tasks, AsymSpec achieves 2.29$\times$ to 4.95$\times$ speedup over autoregressive decoding, outperforming standard speculative decoding without model retraining.

papers.title: Looped Models are Fast Multi-Token Predictors
papers.title_zh: 循环模型是快速的多token预测器
papers.summary_zh: Floodgates用掩码token后缀并行草拟，使循环语言模型自投机解码最高加速7.5倍。
papers.abstract_zh: 循环语言模型可以通过调整循环次数，在不按比例增加独特参数量的情况下为每个 token 调整计算量。这一特性已被用于自投机解码：以浅层循环作为快速草稿器、深层循环作为验证器，由于草稿阶段仍使用全部参数，因此十分有效。本文表明，浅层循环也能预测多个未来 token，并借此大幅加速循环语言模型的推理。为此我们提出 ==Floodgates==，一种简单的自投机解码方法：在序列末尾追加一块掩码 token，并通过低秩适配（LoRA）学习并行草拟这些 token。在七个模型、五个基准、多种批大小以及贪心和采样解码下，**Floodgates 在大多数情况下是最快的无损解码方法，加速最高达 7.5 倍**。分析表明，这一加速得益于循环模型的==全深度训练==，以及浅层草稿器可通过验证阶段算出的深层前缀缓存来利用全深度计算。
papers.abstract_en: Looped language models can adapt computation for predicting a token without a proportional rescaling in unique model parameters by adjusting the number of loops. This property has been used for self-speculative decoding, taking shallow loops as fast drafters and deep loops as verifiers, which is effective since drafting still uses full parameters. In this paper, we show that shallow loops can be also predictive of several future tokens and leverage this to drastically accelerate the inference of looped language models. To that end, we present Floodgates, a simple self-speculative decoding method that appends a block of mask tokens as a suffix and learns via low-rank adaptation to draft these tokens in parallel. Across seven models, five benchmarks, a range of batch sizes, and both greedy and sampled decoding, Floodgates is the fastest lossless decoding method in most cases, attaining up to 7.5x acceleration. Through analysis, we show that this speedup is enabled by all-depth training of looped models, with the shallow drafter's ability to leverage full-depth computation by conditioning on deep prefix cache evaluated during verification.

papers.title: ScanAR: Parallel Row-Scan Decoding for Efficient Image Generation in Unified Autoregressive Models
papers.title_zh: ScanAR：统一自回归模型中面向高效图像生成的并行行扫描解码
papers.summary_zh: 将视觉解码深度从HW降到H+W，在Emu3.5-Image-34B上生成512×512图像快13.8倍。
papers.abstract_zh: 统一多模态自回归（AR）模型把文本和图像放在同一 token 序列中，用共享的下一 token 预测头生成所有模态。然而其图像生成按光栅顺序逐 token 解码 H×W 的视觉网格，需要 HW 个串行步骤，主导了推理时间。现有视觉 AR 生成加速方法要么改变分词器、预测头或模型接口，要么保留模型但无法在不损失质量的情况下实现高并行度，因此无法迁移到统一 AR 模型。我们提出 ==ScanAR==，一种仅重新定义视觉 token 前驱的==行扫描并行解码==方法：第一行视觉 token 照常从左到右生成，之后每一行在单个并行步骤中生成，每个 token 由上一行垂直对齐的 token 预测；非视觉 token 仍遵循标准自回归规则。ScanAR 将视觉解码深度从 HW 降到 H+W，不改变主干网络、词表或输出头，也不增加参数，既支持从头训练，也支持轻量后训练。在 Emu3.5-Image-34B 上，ScanAR 后训练取得 82.36 的 GenEval 分数，是相同数据训练的后训练加速方法中最好的，并且**在相同推理设置下生成 512×512 图像比光栅解码快 13.8 倍**。在 ImageNet 上，从头训练的 ScanAR 在各模型规模下吞吐最高，FID 与光栅 LlamaGen 相当。在 34B 的 Xiaomi-Robotics-U0 模型上，ScanAR 保持了具身场景生成、图文交错生成和视频生成的整体质量。
papers.abstract_en: Unified multimodal autoregressive (AR) models represent text and images in one token sequence and generate all modalities with a shared next-token prediction head. Their image generation, however, decodes an $H\times W$ visual grid token by token in raster order, which takes $HW$ sequential steps and dominates inference time. Existing acceleration methods for visual AR generation either change the tokenizer, the prediction head, or the model interface, or keep the model but cannot reach high parallelism without losing quality, so they do not carry over to unified AR models. We propose ScanAR, a row-scan parallel decoding method that only redefines the predecessors of visual tokens. The first visual row is generated from left to right as usual, and each later row is generated in a single parallel step, with every token predicted from the vertically aligned token of the previous row. Nonvisual tokens keep the standard autoregressive rule. ScanAR reduces the visual decoding depth from $HW$ to $H+W$ without changing the backbone, vocabulary, or output head and without adding parameters, and it supports both training from scratch and lightweight post-training. On Emu3.5-Image-34B, ScanAR post-training reaches a GenEval score of 82.36, the best among post-training acceleration methods trained on the same data, and generates $512\times512$ images $13.8\times$ faster than raster decoding under the same inference setting. On ImageNet, ScanAR trained from scratch has the highest throughput at every model size with FID comparable to raster LlamaGen. On the 34B Xiaomi-Robotics-U0 model, ScanAR preserves the overall quality of embodied scene generation, interleaved image-text generation, and video generation.

papers.title: FlyingStart: Learned Cross-Token Warm Starts for Fixed-Point Decoding in Recurrent-Depth Language Models
papers.title_zh: FlyingStart：循环深度语言模型定点解码的学习式跨 Token 热启动
papers.summary_zh: 用闭式拟合的线性热启动减少循环深度模型解码时的迭代层数。
papers.abstract_zh: 循环深度语言模型通过迭代一个共享的层块来生成每个 token，直到其隐状态收敛。这类模型的推理方法决定何时停止迭代，但每个 token 仍从随机噪声开始，并要付出完整的收敛代价。我们证明，迭代从哪里开始是第二个独立的杠杆：经过一次学到的坐标变换后，一个 token 的不动点可以由上一个 token 停止时的状态预测。我们提出 ==FlyingStart==，一种在冻结模型上闭式拟合的线性热启动，开销不到一次循环的5%。迭代及其停止规则保持不变，因此退出准则从任何起点都能认证到不动点的同样距离：更好的起点可在精度不变的情况下减少循环次数。在 Huginn-0125 上，**FlyingStart 与最强的免训练基线精度相当，解码层数减少14–19%，在两个服务引擎中批处理吞吐提升16–18%，并在自推测解码之上再提升10–14%。**收缩分析可预测我们研究的全部四个模型节省的循环数（其中一个模型的预测在任何评估之前就已记录），在 Huginn 上还能逐 token 预测，并指出了热启动何时有收益：节省量随模型收敛所需循环数的增加而增大。
papers.abstract_en: Recurrent-depth language models generate each token by iterating a shared block of layers until its hidden state converges. Inference methods for these models decide when to stop the iteration, yet every token still starts from random noise and pays the full cost of converging. We show that where the iteration starts is a second, independent lever. A token's fixed point is predictable from the state at which the previous token stopped, after a learned change of coordinates, and we introduce FlyingStart, a linear warm start that is fitted in closed form on the frozen model and costs under 5% of one loop. The iteration and its stopping rule are unchanged, so the exit criterion certifies the same distance to the fixed point from any start: a better start removes loops at unchanged accuracy. On Huginn-0125, FlyingStart matches the accuracy of the strongest training-free baseline with 14--19% fewer decoding layers, raises batched throughput by 16--18% in two serving engines, and adds a further 10--14% on top of self-speculative decoding. A contraction analysis predicts the number of loops saved on all four models we study, including one where the prediction was recorded before any evaluation, and token by token on Huginn, and it identifies when a warm start pays off: the saving grows with the number of loops a model needs to converge.

papers.title: Any-Rate: Half-Bit Multi-Precision LLM Quantization with Coded Bit-Planes
papers.title_zh: Any-Rate：基于编码比特平面的半比特多精度 LLM 量化
papers.summary_zh: 用编码比特平面从单个检查点提供2到8比特、半比特步长的多精度量化。
papers.abstract_zh: 嵌套式多精度量化只读取每个权重的前几位，就能从单个检查点得到多种精度，因此很适合在内存和能耗预算变化的端侧部署。然而，现有方法只提供整数比特，相邻精度之间存在很大的精度差距，并且在 2 比特时严重退化。为此，我们提出 ==Any-Rate==，它能从单个检查点提供 2 至 8 比特的精度，并在 2 至 4 比特范围内以半比特为步长。Any-Rate 把部分比特平面限制为 8 权重分块上的扩展汉明码字（每权重 0.5 比特），让每一行在各精度间共享一个 LUT，并为每个精度设置单独目标进行联合编码，以减少共享比特平面造成的损失。在四个 LLM 上，Any-Rate 在 2 比特和 3 比特下取得多精度方法中最优的精度，**2 比特时保留 FP16 精度的 69%**，4 比特时与最优方法相差在一个点以内。它的解码速度与现有算子大致相当，LPDDR 能耗模型估计在相同精度下**最多可节省 27% 的能耗**。代码已开源：https://github.com/hoonki2002/Any-Rate。
papers.abstract_en: Nested multi-precision quantization derives multiple precisions from a single checkpoint by reading only the leading bits of each weight, which makes it attractive for on-device deployment under varying memory and energy budgets. However, existing methods offer only integer bits, leaving large accuracy gaps between adjacent precisions and severe degradation at 2 bits. To address this, we propose Any-Rate, which serves 2-8 bits from one checkpoint, in half-bit steps over 2-4 bits. Any-Rate restricts some bit-planes to extended Hamming codewords in 8-weight blocks (0.5 bits per weight), shares one LUT per row across precisions, and encodes all precisions jointly with a separate target for each, reducing the loss from sharing bit-planes. Across four LLMs, Any-Rate achieves state-of-the-art accuracy among multi-precision methods at 2 and 3 bits, keeping 69% of FP16 accuracy at 2 bits, and is within one point of the best at 4 bits. It decodes about as fast as existing kernels, and an LPDDR energy model estimates up to 27% less energy at equal accuracy. Code is available at https://github.com/hoonki2002/Any-Rate.

papers.title: Libtt: A Compiler and Runtime for Tenstorrent Processors
papers.title_zh: Libtt：面向 Tenstorrent 处理器的编译器与运行时
papers.summary_zh: 通过实现PJRT接口，让JAX与PyTorch直接运行在Tenstorrent硬件上。
papers.abstract_zh: Libtt 把 PyTorch 和 JAX 生态带到 Tenstorrent 硬件上。它实现了 PJRT，即基于 XLA 的框架驱动 Google TPU 所用的接口，因此 JAX 可以直接运行，PyTorch 通过 TorchTPU 运行，为 TPU 编写的软件除了需要替换自定义算子之外无需修改即可迁移。Libtt 构建在 Tenstorrent 开源的编译器和运行时之上，把从编译器到多芯片运行时的整个软件栈打包为单个共享库。它对上游 Tenstorrent 软件做了大量修复，使现有 PyTorch 和 JAX 代码开箱即用，并新增了大量编译器优化以提升速度。它通过了大部分 JAX 和 TorchTPU 测试套件，并能运行 SGLang、TorchTitan 和 Miles，涵盖推理服务、微调和强化学习。代码：https://github.com/pcmoritz/libtt。
papers.abstract_en: Libtt brings the PyTorch and JAX ecosystem to Tenstorrent hardware. It implements PJRT, the interface through which XLA-based frameworks drive Google's TPUs, so JAX runs on it directly, PyTorch runs through TorchTPU, and software written for TPUs carries over with no changes except replacing custom kernels. Built on Tenstorrent's open-source compiler and runtime, libtt ships the entire stack, from the compiler to the multi-chip runtime, as a single shared library. It contains extensive fixes to the upstream Tenstorrent software to make existing PyTorch and JAX code work out of the box, and extensive new compiler optimizations to make it fast. It passes most of the JAX and TorchTPU test suites and runs SGLang, TorchTitan, and Miles, covering serving, fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning.

papers.title: Letting Models Manage Their Own Context: Where We Stand
papers.title_zh: 让模型管理自己的上下文：现状如何
papers.summary_zh: 让模型通过上下文API自行压缩历史，并用KV缓存复用降低编辑后的prefill开销。
papers.abstract_zh: 当前的智能体运行框架（harness）代替模型管理上下文：窗口填满时，由框架触发压缩来总结历史。我们研究另一种方案，即==模型驱动的上下文管理==，由模型自己通过上下文API决定何时、压缩什么。我们在NVIDIA的开源智能体框架nooa中赋予模型对自身上下文的控制权，并在文档研究和机器学习工程任务上，针对8K到512K token的上下文预算比较了两种策略。能有效使用上下文API的模型取得更高准确率，且常常输入token更少，在预算紧张时尤其明显：**GPT 6.1在32K预算下的得分几乎翻了三倍**（OfficeQA Pro v2上由21%升至56%），**Kimi的输入token最多减少41%**。不过，各模型使用API的频率、压缩的激进程度和开始压缩的时机差异很大，提示词的改动也会改变这一时机。最后我们表明，推理引擎可以让模型驱动的编辑更便宜：编辑后复用未变化后缀的KV缓存，可将每个请求的prefill计算**最多减少15%，且准确率无可测量的变化**。这些结果共同指向一个新的协同设计前沿：训练模型管理自己的上下文，并由支持KV缓存编辑的推理引擎提供服务。
papers.abstract_en: Agent harnesses today manage context on the model's behalf: when the window fills, the harness triggers a compaction that summarizes the history. We study the alternative, \emph{model-driven} context management, in which the model itself decides when and what to compact through a context API. We gave models control over their own context in \nooa, NVIDIA's open source agent harness, and compared the two strategies on document research and machine learning engineering across context budgets from 8K to 512K tokens. Models that use the context API effectively reach higher accuracy, often with fewer input tokens, especially at tight budgets: \textbf{GPT 6.1 nearly triples its score at a 32K budget} on OfficeQA Pro v2 (21\%~$\rightarrow$~56\%), and \textbf{Kimi gains with up to 41\% fewer input tokens}. Models differ widely, however, in how often they use the API, how aggressively they compact, and when they start compacting, and prompt changes shift that timing. Finally, we show that \textbf{inference engines can make model-driven edits cheaper}: by reusing the KV cache of the unchanged suffix after an edit, \textbf{we cut prefill compute by up to 15\% per request with no measurable change in accuracy}. Together, these results point to a new co-design frontier: models trained to manage their own context, served by inference engines that support KV cache editing.

papers.title: BReD: Block Replay Dithering for Stable Low-Bit EMA Optimizer States
papers.title_zh: BReD：面向稳定低比特EMA优化器状态的块重放抖动
papers.summary_zh: 通过种子重放与块共享抖动量化优化器状态，4比特下训练效果接近全精度。
papers.abstract_zh: 低比特存储优化器状态可大幅降低大规模训练的显存占用。但实际训练中这些状态并非只量化一次：每一步都要反量化、更新、再量化并写回，这条迭代量化流水线可能使训练不稳定。我们找出了背后的失效模式：对于通过指数移动平均（EMA）更新的状态，量化误差会递归地进入后续更新，因此有偏误差随时间累积，高方差误差被放大，在EMA衰减因子接近1时尤为明显。为抑制误差累积，我们提出 ==BReD（Block Replay Dithering，块重放抖动）==，用于降低舍入偏差并控制舍入方差。BReD 将经典的减法抖动（subtractive dithering）适配到优化器状态量化中，结合==确定性种子重放==与==块级共享抖动值==，既无需额外存储随机张量，也避免逐元素生成抖动值。在默认预训练设置（120M 规模下的五种优化器；1.1B 和 3.4B 模型上的 AdamW 与 Muon）和监督微调（7B 模型上的 AdamW 与 Muon）中，**4 比特 BReD 与全精度优化器状态的训练结果非常接近，预训练 PPL 偏移 ≤0.5，微调 ≤0.2，下游平均性能变化在 0.7 分以内**。此外，3 比特 BReD 在所评测的设置中仍能稳定收敛，是更激进的选择。BReD 的实现已开源：https://github.com/ZhanHeshen/BReD
papers.abstract_en: Low-bit storage of optimizer states can substantially reduce the memory footprint of large-scale training. In practice, however, these states are not quantized once: at every training step, they are dequantized, updated, requantized, and written back. This iterative quantization pipeline can destabilize training. We identify a failure mode behind this instability: for states updated via exponential moving averages (EMAs), quantization errors are recursively fed into subsequent updates. As a result, biased errors accumulate over time while high-variance errors are amplified, particularly when the EMA decay factor is close to 1. To address this error accumulation, we propose BReD (Block Replay Dithering), a method that reduces rounding bias and controls rounding variance during quantization. BReD adapts classical subtractive dithering to optimizer-state quantization by combining deterministic seed replay with block-wise shared dither values, avoiding auxiliary random-tensor storage and per-element dither values generation. Across the default pretraining settings (five optimizers at 120M; AdamW and Muon at 1.1B and 3.4B model) and supervised fine-tuning (AdamW and Muon at 7B model), 4-bit BReD closely matches training with full-precision optimizer states, with PPL shifts $\leq0.5$ in pretraining and $\leq0.2$ in fine-tuning and average downstream performance changes within 0.7 points. Moreover, 3-bit BReD preserves stable convergence in the evaluated settings, offering a more aggressive alternative. Our implementation of BReD is available at: https://github.com/ZhanHeshen/BReD

papers.title: LiveVAE: Causal Window Attention Makes Efficient Streaming Video VAE
papers.title_zh: LiveVAE：因果窗口注意力让流式视频 VAE 更高效
papers.summary_zh: 用因果窗口注意力替换视频 VAE 的全局注意力，编码解码大幅提速。
papers.abstract_zh: 视频扩散模型越来越快、越来越适合流式生成，但视频 VAE 仍是交互式生成与编辑流水线的主要延迟瓶颈。现有 VAE 及其加速方法主要依赖厚重的卷积或全帧注意力，且大多只关注解码，使得流式条件生成与编辑中的编码依然昂贵。这引出一个自然的问题：视频 VAE 的编码与解码真的需要这样的全局时空建模吗？通过分析预训练视频 VAE 的有效感受野，我们发现无论编码还是解码，一个 patch 几乎完全依赖其空间与时间邻域。为利用这种强局部性，我们提出 LiveVAE，一种基于==因果窗口注意力==的流式编码器与解码器，在降低逐帧计算量的同时让时间维度的 KV cache 保持有界。先对编码器和解码器分别蒸馏，再联合微调，从而保留预训练的潜空间，使 LiveVAE 可直接替换原始 VAE。在 MiniMax-H3 上，LiveVAE 的编码比官方 VAE 快 5.2–6.2 倍，解码快 3.0–3.3 倍，且 PSNR 更高。配合我们专用的推理基础设施，**加速可达 13.4 倍，几乎没有质量损失**。代码和模型将会发布。
papers.abstract_en: While video diffusion models have grown faster and increasingly streamable, the video VAE remains a primary latency bottleneck across interactive generation and editing pipelines. Existing VAEs and their acceleration methods rely mainly on heavy convolutions or full frame attention, and most focus only on decoding, leaving encoding costly for streaming conditional generation and editing. This raises a natural question: Do video VAE encoding and decoding actually require such global spatiotemporal modeling? By analyzing the effective receptive fields of pretrained video VAEs, we find that both encoding and decoding a patch rely almost entirely on its spatial and temporal neighbors. To exploit this strong locality, we introduce LiveVAE, a streaming encoder and decoder built on causal window attention, which cuts per frame compute while keeping the temporal KV cache bounded for streaming. Decoupled encoder/decoder distillation followed by joint finetuning preserves the pretrained latent space, making LiveVAE a drop-in replacement for the original VAE. On MiniMax-H3, LiveVAE achieves 5.2-6.2x faster encoding and 3.0-3.3x faster decoding than the official VAE with higher PSNR. Paired with our dedicated inference infrastructure, LiveVAE pushes the speedup to 13.4x with almost no quality loss. Code and models will be released.

papers.title: ShowNow: Fine-Grained Speculative Streaming for Responsive World Models
papers.title_zh: ShowNow：面向响应式世界模型的细粒度投机流式生成
papers.summary_zh: 利用播放期间的空闲算力提前准备多个动作条件的未来，降低输入到显示延迟。
papers.abstract_zh: 交互式世界模型必须持续生成视频，同时及时响应用户动作。仅有实时吞吐并不能解决输入延迟：粗粒度的生成块会推迟动作更新，而在输入之后再生成则会给响应路径增加工作量。我们提出 ShowNow，一种==细粒度投机流式==框架，利用播放期间的可用算力，在输入到来之前准备以动作为条件的未来。单 latent 提交使频繁决策成为可能，可配置的准备机制可覆盖一到八个动作。我们构建了一个匹配的多未来数据集，用于从共同状态训练多个可选的后续；共享历史的树式执行与融合提交使这些准备工作更高效。在单张 H100 上，我们的 5B 模型在准备八个未来的情况下以 16 fps 持续生成 480p 视频。在 ViZDoom 中，相比原生分块的 SolarWM-FT 部署，完整的 ShowNow 部署将**输入到显示的中位延迟从 620 ms 降到 208 ms**。在匹配策略的实验中，重启空 tick 从 1.56% 降到 0.09%（降低 94%），并提升了对动作变化的按时响应。这些结果表明细粒度提交与提前准备各自发挥互补作用，同时也存在视觉保真度与长时程一致性方面的权衡。ShowNow 把播放期间的计算转化为响应式的视觉交互。项目地址：https://github.com/showlab/ShowNow。
papers.abstract_en: Interactive world models must generate video continuously while responding promptly to user actions. Real-time throughput alone leaves input latency unresolved: coarse generation blocks delay action updates, and generation after input adds work to the response path. We introduce ShowNow, a fine-grained speculative streaming framework that uses computation available during playback to prepare action-conditioned futures before input arrives. Single-latent commitment enables frequent decisions, while configurable preparation covers one to eight actions. We construct a matched multi-future dataset to train alternative continuations from a common state; shared-history tree execution and fused commitment make their preparation efficient. On a single H100, our 5B model sustains 480p generation at 16 fps with eight prepared futures. In ViZDoom, the complete ShowNow deployment reduces median input-to-display latency from 620 to 208 ms relative to the native-block SolarWM-FT deployment. Matched-policy experiments reduce restart empty ticks from 1.56% to 0.09% (94%) and improve on-time responses to action changes. These results establish complementary roles for fine-grained commitment and advance preparation, with measured trade-offs in visual fidelity and long-horizon consistency. ShowNow turns playback-time computation into responsive visual interaction. Project: https://github.com/showlab/ShowNow.

papers.title: TORE: Token-Wise Taylor Order Selection via Decomposed Residual Error Estimation for Diffusion Acceleration
papers.title_zh: TORE：通过分解残差误差估计实现逐 token 泰勒阶数选择的扩散加速
papers.summary_zh: 按估计的完整模型残差预测误差为每个 token 选泰勒阶数，加速扩散推理。
papers.abstract_zh: 扩散模型在图像和视频生成上表现出色，但迭代去噪带来了可观的推理延迟。近期的 token 自适应加速方法利用浅层代理分数为完整模型的残差选择泰勒预测阶数。然而候选阶数是在代理特征上评估的，却用于预测完整模型的残差，这造成了代理与目标之间的不匹配：代理偏好的阶数未必能使残差预测误差最小。为解决这一问题，我们提出 TORE（Taylor Order selection via Residual Error estimation），它基于对完整模型残差预测误差的估计来选择逐 token 的泰勒阶数。但直接评估误差需要未来的真实残差，而这在选择阶数时是得不到的。因此 TORE 通过分析泰勒外推中误差的产生方式来估计预测误差：它把预测误差分解为==截断误差==与==有限差分导数误差==，再用缓存的残差估计两者的贡献，从而为即将到来的跳步预先选定逐 token 的阶数。大量实验表明，TORE 在保持高生成质量与保真度的同时，**在 FLUX.1-dev 上实现 4.31 倍加速，在 Wan2.1 上实现 4.18 倍加速**。
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models excel at image and video generation, but iterative denoising incurs substantial inference latency. Recent token-adaptive acceleration methods select Taylor prediction orders for the full-model residual using shallow-layer proxy scores. However, candidate orders are evaluated on these proxy features but used to predict the full-model residual, creating a proxy--target mismatch: the proxy-preferred order may not minimize residual prediction error. To address this mismatch, we propose \textbf{TORE} (\textbf{T}aylor \textbf{O}rder selection via \textbf{R}esidual \textbf{E}rror estimation), which selects token-wise Taylor orders based on estimated prediction errors for the full-model residual. Yet direct error evaluation requires future ground-truth residuals, which are unavailable during order selection. TORE therefore estimates prediction error by analyzing how errors arise in Taylor extrapolation. Specifically, it decomposes prediction error into truncation error and finite-difference derivative error, then estimates both contributions from cached residuals to preselect token-wise orders for upcoming skip steps. Extensive experiments show that TORE achieves $4.31\times$ speedup on FLUX.1-dev and $4.18\times$ on Wan2.1 while maintaining high generation quality and fidelity.

papers.title: SprintGS: Eliminating Redundancy for Fast 3D Gaussian Splatting Training
papers.title_zh: SprintGS：消除冗余以加速 3D 高斯泼溅训练
papers.summary_zh: 针对 FastGS 的光栅化与损失计算冗余做优化，训练再提速 2.15 倍。
papers.abstract_zh: 3D 高斯泼溅（3DGS）可以实时渲染逼真的新视角，但逐场景的训练（优化）仍然很慢。FastGS 等近期快速训练方法通过减少高斯数量把训练缩短到几分钟。对 FastGS 做性能剖析后，我们发现即使在其紧凑模型中仍有两项成本存在。第一，光栅化仍是最大开销，其中还有冗余工作。第二，损失计算不会随高斯数量减少而缩小，因此模型越紧凑，其在训练时间中的占比越大。我们提出 SprintGS，一个构建在 FastGS 之上的训练框架，在保持模型紧凑的同时降低这两项成本。对于光栅化，==调度式 tile 裁剪==用粗略的足迹把每个高斯限制在其起作用的 tile 内，并在训练结束前逐步退火到精确足迹；==收敛感知剪枝==移除已收敛且近乎透明的高斯；==shuffle 高效的反向传播==减少 GPU 线程间交换的数据。对于损失，==融合损失==在前向中直接计算损失及其图像梯度而无需损失图，去除了其大部分开销。**SprintGS 在质量相当的情况下训练速度是 FastGS 的 2.15 倍，在其高质量设置下为 1.81 倍**。它还能加速其他快速训练方法，以及动态、稀疏视角和表面重建任务。
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) renders photorealistic novel views in real time, but its per-scene training (optimization) remains slow. Recent fast training methods such as FastGS shorten training to a few minutes by reducing the number of Gaussians. Profiling FastGS, we find two costs that remain even in its compact model. First, rasterization is still the largest cost, and redundant work remains in it. Second, the loss computation does not shrink with the number of Gaussians, so its share of the training time grows as the model becomes compact. We present SprintGS, a training framework built on FastGS that keeps the model compact and reduces both costs. For rasterization, scheduled tile culling limits each Gaussian to the tiles where it matters, using a coarse footprint that is annealed to the exact one before training ends; convergence-aware pruning removes converged, nearly transparent Gaussians; and a shuffle-efficient backward pass reduces the data exchanged between GPU threads. For the loss, a fused loss computes the loss and its image gradient in the forward pass without a loss map, removing most of its cost. SprintGS trains 2.15x faster than FastGS at comparable quality, and 1.81x faster in its high-quality setting. It also accelerates other fast training methods and dynamic, sparse-view, and surface reconstruction.

papers.title: VAPOR: Improving Multimodal Reasoning with Sparse Visual Updates
papers.title_zh: VAPOR：用稀疏视觉更新改进多模态推理
papers.summary_zh: 免训练地跨解码步复用视觉注意力输出并按需刷新，解码提速 1.11–1.21 倍。
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在视觉推理上取得了显著进展，但在大量视觉上下文上进行长文本生成的计算代价依然很高。在自回归解码中，即使相邻 token 依赖相似的视觉证据，视觉注意力仍要为每个生成的 token 重新计算。我们提出 VAPOR（Visual Attention Persistence with On-demand Refresh），一个免训练框架，通过在解码步之间复用视觉注意力输出并在需要时刷新来减少这种冗余。VAPOR 缓存视觉注意力输出，同时在每一步继续更新文本注意力，有助于减轻长推理过程中的视觉接地漂移。为决定何时复用缓存的输出，VAPOR 用低秩近似估计视觉注意力质量，并结合基于 prefill 的注意力一致性与缓存年龄，对每个注意力头独立做出==保持==与==刷新==的决定。VAPOR 保留完整的视觉 KV cache，因此新证据需要时所有视觉 token 仍然可用。在两个 MLLM 家族上的八个图像和四个视频推理基准中，VAPOR 在几乎所有基准上精度都高于稠密注意力，同时**实现 1.11–1.21 倍的解码加速**。与各设置下最强的最先进加速基线相比，VAPOR 的精度还进一步高出 0.35–2.15 个百分点，同时解码延迟相当或更低。代码见 https://github.com/Su-my/VAPOR。
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made substantial progress in visual reasoning, but extended generation over large visual contexts remains computationally expensive. During autoregressive decoding, visual attention is recomputed for every generated token, even when consecutive tokens rely on similar visual evidence. We introduce VAPOR (Visual Attention Persistence with On-demand Refresh), a training-free framework that reduces this redundancy by reusing visual attention outputs across decoding steps and refreshing them when needed. VAPOR caches the visual attention output while continuing to update textual attention at every step, helping reduce visual grounding drift during extended reasoning. To decide when to reuse cached outputs, VAPOR estimates visual attention mass using a low-rank approximation. It also uses prefill-based attention consistency and cache age to make independent Persist and Refresh decisions for each attention head. VAPOR retains the full visual key-value (KV) cache, so all visual tokens remain available when new evidence is needed. Experiments on eight image and four video reasoning benchmarks across two MLLM families show that VAPOR improves accuracy over dense attention on nearly all benchmarks while achieving 1.11-1.21x decoding speedups. Compared with the strongest state-of-the-art acceleration baseline in each setting, VAPOR further improves accuracy by 0.35-2.15 percentage points while achieving comparable or lower decoding latency. Our code is available at https://github.com/Su-my/VAPOR.

papers.title: A Differential Computing Accelerator for LLM Inference Leveraging Bit-Slice Transition Sparsity
papers.title_zh: 利用比特切片跳变稀疏性的 LLM 推理差分计算加速器
papers.summary_zh: 提出复用比特切片部分和的 LLM 推理加速器 ISTS。
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）已成为现代人工智能的基础。在缩放定律的驱动下，其快速增长给部署带来了越来越大的计算和内存挑战。为加速主导 LLM 计算的通用矩阵乘法（GEMM），比特切片架构沿比特维度分解量化后的操作数，从而暴露切片级的稀疏性和冗余。然而，现有的比特切片设计主要利用高位切片中的稀疏性，而稠密的低位切片仍有大量尚未挖掘的复用机会。我们观察到，比特切片向量（BSV）在 Hamming 空间中高度聚集，许多 BSV 与一小组代表性模式只相差几次比特翻转。基于这一观察，我们提出 ISTS，一种算法-硬件协同设计的加速器，它把代表性 BSV 模式作为共享的 ==Steiner 点==，在切片之间复用部分和，从而大幅减少计算。具体而言，每个目标 BSV 的部分和可以由其所属 Steiner 点的部分和仅通过少量加减法重建。算法方面，我们提出 Steiner 吸收表构建（SATC），选出一个紧凑的 Steiner 点集合，吸收只需少量双向比特翻转的 BSV；FlipPrune 则选择性地剪掉部分翻转，进一步扩大可复用的 BSV 群体。硬件方面，我们设计了一个轻量级加速器，同时支持静态线性层权重和运行时生成的注意力 K/V 张量的 Steiner 复用。综合评估表明，**ISTS 相比最先进的加速器 ANT、BBS、LUT Tensor Core、Transitive Array 和 MCBP-BRCR，平均加速比分别为 $3.09\times$、$2.41\times$、$2.18\times$、$1.27\times$ 和 $1.41\times$。**
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have become foundational to modern artificial intelligence. Driven by scaling laws, their rapid growth poses increasing computational and memory challenges for deployment. To accelerate the general matrix multiplication (GEMM) operations that dominate LLM computation, bit-slice architectures decompose quantized operands along the bit dimension, exposing slice-level sparsity and redundancy. However, existing bit-slice designs primarily exploit sparsity in high-order slices, while dense low-order slices still offer substantial untapped reuse opportunities. We observe that bit-slice vectors (BSVs) are highly clustered in Hamming space, with many BSVs lying only a few bit flips away from a small set of representative patterns. Based on this observation, we propose ISTS, an algorithm-hardware co-designed accelerator that leverages representative BSV patterns as shared Steiner points to reuse partial sums across slices, substantially reducing computation. Specifically, the partial sum of each target BSV can be reconstructed from that of its assigned Steiner point using only a few additions or subtractions. On the algorithmic side, we propose Steiner Absorption Table Construction (SATC), which selects a compact set of Steiner points to absorb BSVs with only a few bidirectional bit flips, while FlipPrune selectively prunes flips to further expand the reusable BSV population. On the hardware side, we design a lightweight accelerator that supports Steiner reuse for static linear layer weights and runtime-generated attention K/V tensors. Comprehensive evaluations show that ISTS achieves average speedups of $3.09\times$, $2.41\times$, $2.18\times$, $1.27\times$, and $1.41\times$ over the state-of-the-art accelerators ANT, BBS, LUT Tensor Core, Transitive Array, and MCBP-BRCR, respectively.

papers.title: CoordRoute: Coordinated Multi-Model Routing for Maximum Compute-Budget Utility
papers.title_zh: CoordRoute：面向最大化算力预算效用的协同多模型路由
papers.summary_zh: 在共享算力预算下协同分配请求到不同规模LLM，总体满意度提升18.72%。
papers.abstract_zh: 模型路由将每个请求发送到若干不同规模的大语言模型（LLM）之一。实际中，请求共享固定的算力预算：租用模型API的花费上限，或私有GPU集群的容量。现有路由器大多不考虑总预算，各自独立决策，因此逐请求最优并不等于整体最优。我们提出==协同路由==，沿“预测—规划—修正”的路径在请求之间分配预算，以最大化其效用，即总体满意度：预测每个模型的产出与成本，针对后续请求规划选择，并在生成过程中进行修正。每一步都面临挑战：请求从各模型获得的收益在生成前不确定，请求必须启动时后续到达者未知，而在生成过程中观察答案本身也会消耗预算。CoordRoute通过三个部件应对：相对需求预测，通过导向相同路由选择的历史请求来比较候选模型；前瞻求解器，按每个选择的算力在后续请求上本可获得的收益来计价；以及预算感知的运行时修正，以相同代价丢弃或升级进行中的请求，仅在值得时才检查答案。在Azure Conversation和BurstGPT轨迹上，CoordRoute将总体满意度比最强的现有路由器**提升了18.72%**。
papers.abstract_en: Model routing sends each request to one of several large language models (LLMs) of different sizes. In practice, requests share a fixed compute budget: a spending cap on rented model APIs or the capacity of a private GPU cluster. Most existing routers do not account for the total budget: each decides a request on its own, so per-request optima are not optimal overall. We advocate coordinated routing, which allocates the budget across requests to maximize its utility, their total satisfaction, along a predict-plan-rectify route: predict what each model would give and cost, plan the choice against later requests, and rectify it during generation. Each step faces a challenge: a request's gain from each model is uncertain before generation, later arrivals are unknown when a request must start, and observing answers during generation consumes the budget itself. CoordRoute addresses them with relative demand prediction, which compares candidate models through past requests that lead to the same routing choices; a lookahead solver, which charges each choice for what its compute could earn for later requests; and budget-aware runtime correction, which drops or upgrades in-flight requests at the same price, inspecting answers only when it pays off. On Azure Conversation and BurstGPT traces, CoordRoute improves total satisfaction by 18.72% over the strongest existing router.

papers.title: SentryWard: Formal Verification of Warp-Specialized GPU Kernels
papers.title_zh: SentryWard：warp特化GPU内核的形式化验证
papers.summary_zh: 形式化验证warp特化GPU内核的同步、数据竞争与功能等价性。
papers.abstract_zh: 现代 GPU 内核利用 warp 特化，使异步数据搬运、通用核心（如 CUDA 核心）上的计算与专用核心（如张量核心）上的计算相互重叠。这些异步重叠优化带来复杂的同步要求：异步操作排序错误会导致数据竞争、资源过早复用和结果错误。仅靠测试无法保证正确性，因为这类错误具有不确定性，可能只在罕见的执行调度下出现，而现有 GPU 形式化验证技术对 warp 特化内核的支持有限。我们提出 ==SentryWard==，一个用于形式化验证 warp 特化 GPU 内核的框架，集成了同步验证、数据竞争与资源生命周期分析以及功能等价性检查。其核心思想是==证明同步在所有可能的执行调度下诱导出相同的顺序约束==。SentryWard 将良同步（well-synchronization）分析扩展到带异步事务跟踪的现代 GPU 屏障，并导出==与调度无关的 happens-before 图==，再用该图验证内存安全并构造符号输出表达式以进行功能等价性检查。SentryWard 通常假设张量形状和内核启动配置已给定并展开循环，同时利用跨线程和张量计算中重复结构的紧凑表示来提升可扩展性。SentryWard 已公开：https://github.com/gpu-verifier/sentryward。
papers.abstract_en: Modern GPU kernels overlap asynchronous data movement, computation on general-purpose cores (e.g., CUDA cores), and computation on specialized cores (e.g., tensor cores) using warp specialization. These asynchronous-overlap optimizations introduce complex synchronization requirements, where incorrect ordering of asynchronous operations can lead to data races, premature resource reuse, and incorrect results. Testing alone cannot guarantee correctness because such errors are nondeterministic and may only manifest in rare execution schedules, and existing GPU formal verification techniques have limited support for warp-specialized kernels. We present SentryWard, a framework for formally verifying warp-specialized GPU kernels. SentryWard integrates synchronization verification, data-race and resource-lifetime analysis, and functional equivalence checking. The key idea is to establish that synchronization induces the same ordering constraints across all possible execution schedules. SentryWard extends this well-synchronization analysis to modern GPU barriers with asynchronous transaction tracking and derives a schedule-independent happens-before graph. It then uses this graph to verify memory safety and construct symbolic output expressions for functional equivalence checking. While SentryWard generally assumes tensor shapes and kernel launch configurations are given and unrolls loops, it uses compact representations of repeated structures across threads and tensor computations to improve scalability. SentryWard is publicly available at https://github.com/gpu-verifier/sentryward.

papers.title: FlashProve-Next: Verifiable Inference for Production LLM APIs
papers.title_zh: FlashProve-Next：面向生产级 LLM API 的可验证推理
papers.summary_zh: 为原生 LLM 推理生成零知识可验证证明，并在 GPU 上给出证明与验证开销。
papers.abstract_zh: 闭源权重 LLM API 的客户无法验证服务商是否真正运行了所宣称的模型、精度、隐藏提示词和推理预算。现有方法要么信任硬件或第三方，要么以高成本为整数代理模型逐层重新证明，且与原生浮点推理相偏离。==FlashProve-Next== 可在不修改原生推理（bf16/fp8/mxfp4、随机采样、FlashAttention、CUDA graphs、批处理、前缀缓存）的前提下，为单次 LLM API 响应生成可验证、零知识掩码的证明，并且不泄露权重、隐藏提示词、隐藏推理或激活值（稠密配置固定粗粒度几何结构，跨架构隐藏留待后续）。一种不耗尽的 Reed-Solomon 权重承诺 model_id 通过隐藏列打开在证明内部打开，局部的逐算子舍入约定则消除了整数代理和拒答位泄露。按成本加权的抽样检查支持非交互式公开验证（NI-315，ε ≤ 2^-40，Q ≤ 2^64）以及外部种子 C_pre 模式（ExtSeed-153，ε ≤ 2^-20，Q_samp ≤ 2^30）。28 个 Lean 4 模块（696 条声明，零 sorry，仅使用标准公理）机械化证明了逐轮可靠性、分桶采样、F_{p^3} 约束掩码绑定、因果掩码、六种 IR gadget 以及可执行的 FPN2 验证器。五个模型在 Blackwell 上的校准显示，在 185 万个 GEMM/MoE 块和 196 万个非 GEMM 行上零误拒。零 Phase-2 折叠后端（折叠 ZK 模拟器开放）在唯一解码 Q=128 下，用 450.2 秒 GPU 时间（10.76 秒 CPU）证明了 Qwen3-0.6B 的 ExtSeed-153（14.7 亿单元，8 MiB），通过 14/14 作弊矩阵，并可扩展到 36 层的 Qwen3-4B（开发配置 4+2）以及运行在线 vLLM 的 Qwen3-30B-A3B-FP8 Relation 6（**证明 1.49 秒，Rust 验证 23.4 毫秒**，公开权重分块）。Rust 的 fpn-verify 在 CPU 上用 10.1 毫秒即可检查 8 MiB 的 FPN2 Relation 2 证明。
papers.abstract_en: Clients of closed-weight LLM APIs cannot verify whether a provider ran the advertised model, precision, hidden prompt, and reasoning budget. Existing approaches either trust hardware or third parties, or re-prove every layer of an integer surrogate at high cost while diverging from native floating-point serving. FlashProve-Next produces verifiable, zero-knowledge-masked proofs for individual LLM API responses without modifying native serving (bf16/fp8/mxfp4, random sampling, FlashAttention, CUDA graphs, batching, prefix caching) and without disclosing weights, hidden prompts, hidden reasoning, or activations (dense profiles fix coarse geometry; cross-architecture hiding is deferred). A non-depleting Reed-Solomon weight commitment model_id opens inside proofs via hidden column openings, while local per-operator rounding contracts remove integer surrogates and the refusal-bit leak. Cost-weighted spot-checking supports non-interactive public verification (NI-315, $\varepsilon \le 2^{-40}$, $Q \le 2^{64}$) and external-seed C_pre mode (ExtSeed-153, $\varepsilon \le 2^{-20}$, $Q_{\rm samp} \le 2^{30}$). Twenty-eight Lean 4 modules (696 declarations, zero sorry, standard axioms only) mechanize round-by-round soundness, bucketed sampling, $\mathbb{F}_{p^3}$ constrained-mask binding, causal masking, six IR gadgets, and executable FPN2 verifiers. Five-model Blackwell calibration gives zero false rejections across 1.85M GEMM/MoE blocks and 1.96M non-GEMM rows. Our zero-Phase-2 folded backend (folded ZK simulator open) proves Qwen3-0.6B ExtSeed-153 (1.47B cells, 8 MiB) in 450.2 s GPU (10.76 s CPU) at unique-decoding $Q=128$, passes a 14/14 cheating matrix, and scales to 36-layer Qwen3-4B (dev $4+2$) and live vLLM Qwen3-30B-A3B-FP8 Relation 6 (1.49 s prove, 23.4 ms Rust verify, public weight tiles). Rust fpn-verify checks 8 MiB FPN2 Relation 2 proofs in 10.1 ms on CPU.

papers.title: L2C2: Enhancing Large-scale Chiplets for Agent Long-Context LLM Inference with Sparse and Distributed Attention
papers.title_zh: L2C2：用稀疏与分布式注意力增强大规模 Chiplet 上的智能体长上下文 LLM 推理
papers.summary_zh: 为 Chiplet 上的分布式稀疏注意力设计通信与缓存均衡优化。
papers.abstract_zh: 长上下文推理是 LLM 日益增长的需求，对智能体应用尤其如此。稀疏注意力（SpAt）和 Chiplet 技术分别有望减少计算量和扩展硬件性能。然而，在分布式 Chiplet 上部署 SpAt 需要用上下文并行来划分负载，从而引入复杂的分布式注意力。本文提出 ==L2C2==，一种面向长上下文推理中分布式 SpAt 的系统优化。在部分预填充阶段，我们提出新的 ==Split-Comm Attention== 机制，利用 Chiplet 的高带宽互连，以通信开销换取更少的访存，并将其与传统的 Ring Attention 结合成 Bi-Mode 方法，以适应不同的输入序列长度。在解码阶段，我们分析了访存不均衡的成因，并通过静态交错的 token 分配来解决，同时提出动态敏捷缓存均衡以适应 SpAt 的偏斜。评测显示，我们的优化在大规模 Chiplet 上使用 SpAt 时，部分预填充和解码分别获得 **1.45 倍和 1.53 倍加速**。
papers.abstract_en: Long-context inference is a rising demand for LLMs, especially for agent applications. Sparse attention (SpAt) and chiplet technology are promising solutions to reduce computations and scale hardware performance. However, deploying SpAt on distributed chiplets necessitates context parallelism for workload partitioning, introducing complex distributed attention. In this work, we present L2C2, a system optimization for distributed SpAt in long-context inference. During the partial-prefill stage, we propose a novel Split-Comm Attention mechanism that leverages the high-bandwidth interconnect of chiplets to trade communication overhead for reduced memory access. We combine it with conventional Ring Attention to form a Bi-Mode method that adapts to varying input sequence lengths. During the decoding stage, we analyze the cause of memory access imbalance and address it by static interleaved token assignment. Dynamic agile cache balancing is also proposed to adapt to SpAt skewness. Evaluations show our optimization can achieve 1.45$\times$ and 1.53$\times$ speedup in partial-prefill and decoding with SpAt on large-scale chiplets.

papers.title: Agentic LongLive: Asynchronous Agentic Memory for Long Video Generation
papers.title_zh: Agentic LongLive：面向长视频生成的异步智能体记忆
papers.summary_zh: 用独立 GPU 上的记忆智能体异步维护实体记忆，几乎不增加生成时间。
papers.abstract_zh: 实时自回归视频生成器可以流式生成数分钟的视频并随时接收新提示词，但在长时间的交互式故事中难以保持人物、物体和场景的一致性。智能体系统可以为离线多镜头生成提供这类记忆，但它们会提前读完整个脚本、先规划每个镜头再生成、并重新生成失败的镜头，而实时流不允许这样做。我们提出 Agentic LongLive，一种用于长视频生成的==异步智能体记忆==。记忆智能体运行在独立的 GPU 上，只读取目前已揭示的提示词而从不读取生成的视频，并为每个人物、物体和场景维护文本状态与不断演化的图像。它基于这份实体记忆合成一张全局图像和一张逐镜头记忆图像，由辅助 GPU 在下一个镜头开始前预填充到生成器的 attention sink 中，并为提到这些实体的提示词写入实体卡片，因此视频无需等待记忆，视频中的错误也不会被写回。一个经强化学习训练的小型语言模型，配合以下游视频结果校准的图像奖励，在下一条提示词未知时决定要记住什么。在 LongStory-Online（一个包含 25 个故事、857 个镜头、逐镜头揭示的新基准）上，Agentic LongLive 将其基础生成器 LongLive-2.0 的持久状态准确率提高 26.3 个点，主角身份一致性提高 44.9，重访场景一致性提高 40.4，而在 H100 上**仅增加约 1% 的生成时间**。完整系统在单个 8xB200 节点上以 BF16 精度运行生成器时，流式速度快于实时（34.3 FPS），在 14 分钟的故事中保持图像质量稳定，并提升了两个 MiniMax-H3 生成器的身份一致性，其中 LongLive-H3 在使用该记忆时同样能实时运行。据我们所知，这是第一个由 LLM 智能体维护文本与图像记忆的实时视频生成器。
papers.abstract_en: Real-time autoregressive video generators stream minutes of video and accept new prompts on the fly, but struggle to keep people, objects, and places consistent over a long interactive story. Agent systems provide such memory for offline multi-shot generation, yet they read the whole script in advance, plan each shot before generating it, and regenerate failed shots, which a live stream does not allow. We present Agentic LongLive, an asynchronous agentic memory for long video generation. A memory agent on separate GPUs reads only the prompts revealed so far, never the generated video, and keeps a text state and evolving images for every person, object, and scene. From this entity memory it composes a global image and a per-shot memory image, which an auxiliary GPU prefills into the generator's attention sink before the next shot starts, and writes entity cards for the prompts that name them, so the video never waits for memory and video errors are not written back. A small language model, trained with reinforcement learning and an image reward calibrated using downstream video outcomes, decides what to remember before the next prompt is known. On LongStory-Online, a new benchmark of 25 stories (857 shots) revealed one shot at a time, Agentic LongLive improves persistent-state accuracy of LongLive-2.0, its base generator, by 26.3 points, protagonist identity by 44.9, and revisited-place consistency by 40.4, at about 1% extra generation time on H100. The full system streams faster than real time on one 8xB200 node with the generator in BF16 (34.3 FPS), keeps image quality stable over 14-minute stories, and improves identity on two MiniMax-H3 generators, one of which, LongLive-H3, also runs in real time with it. To our knowledge, it is the first real-time video generator with text and image memory kept by an LLM agent.

papers.title: From Diagnosing Alignment to Joint Supervision in Multimodal Draft Training
papers.title_zh: 从诊断对齐到多模态草稿训练中的联合监督
papers.summary_zh: 诊断多模态草稿模型与目标模型的对齐，并据风险配比图文监督以提升投机解码。
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态草稿模型可以从多模态（MM）和纯文本（TXT）监督中学习，但二者对对齐的影响以及如何组合仍不清楚。我们通过有无视觉输入的成对预测来诊断草稿与目标模型的对齐，把分布误差分解为文本条件分量与视觉响应分量。文本条件对齐相近的草稿，其视觉响应风险和接受率仍可能相差很大。受控的继续训练表明，高风险组优于随机组和低风险组，并且视觉响应风险比总体风险更能有效地指导 MM 训练。基于这些诊断，我们提出 MNRS-Joint，它根据给定草稿的分量风险分布配置==联合监督==，用各模态的平均风险来确定 MM:TXT 的混合比例。在三种预热设置下，其各异的混合比例都落在比例扫描中的高性能区域。在 LLaVA-1.5-7B 上，贪心树解码下相比组成匹配的随机训练，MNRS-Joint 把**平均接受长度从 3.35 提高到 3.53，平均加速从 2.04 倍提高到 2.16 倍**。这些收益在随机链式解码下同样成立。
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal drafts learn from multimodal (MM) and text-only (TXT) supervision, yet their effects on alignment and how to combine them remain unclear. We diagnose draft-target alignment through paired predictions with and without visual input, decomposing distributional error into text-conditioned and visual-response components. Drafts with similar text-conditioned alignment can still differ markedly in visual-response risk and acceptance. Controlled continuation training shows that high-risk groups outperform random and low-risk groups, and visual-response risk guides MM training more effectively than aggregate risk. Building on these diagnostics, we propose MNRS-Joint, which configures joint supervision from a given draft's component-risk distributions, using modality-specific mean risks to determine the MM:TXT mixture. Across three warm-ups, its distinct mixtures fall in high-performing regions of the ratio sweeps. On LLaVA-1.5-7B, MNRS-Joint improves mean accepted length from 3.35 to 3.53 and mean speedup from $2.04\times$ to $2.16\times$ over composition-matched random training under greedy tree decoding. The gains also hold under stochastic chain decoding.

papers.title: TaCo: Rethinking Correlation for Visual Tracking on Edge Devices
papers.title_zh: TaCo：为边缘设备上的视觉跟踪重新思考相关操作
papers.summary_zh: 用无注意力的目标对齐相关替代注意力，在边缘 NPU 与 CPU 上跟踪更快。
papers.abstract_zh: 轻量级跟踪器已用注意力取代互相关，但在低功耗边缘硬件上这是有代价的：注意力中受访存限制的 softmax、归一化和 reshape 算子耗时远超其算术量所暗示的程度。我们在统一且经过数值验证的协议下，在边缘神经网络处理器（NPU）和 Arm CPU 上对高效跟踪器进行基准测试，发现相关类跟踪器速度更快，但除非采用 ViT 骨干（这又把注意力带了回来），否则精度落后。我们重新审视相关操作缺少什么。模板与搜索区域的交互承担两个作用：以目标为条件调整搜索特征，以及在空间上与目标匹配。注意力两者兼顾，而相关只做匹配，并且作用在提取时不知道目标的特征上。我们提出 TaCo（Target-aligned Correlation），它在不使用注意力的情况下补上缺失的条件作用：让模板仅以每个视频只计算一次的算子形式进入逐帧网络。目标描述子在骨干内部逐通道缩放并平移搜索特征，与目标框对齐的卷积核（各自的权重由模板预测）通过一次矩阵乘法与之相关。在骨干固定时，我们的相关仍然必不可少，同时在 NPU 上几乎不增加开销，相比我们测试的基于注意力的交互提供了更好的速度–精度权衡。**TaCo-T 在 Rockchip RV1126B NPU 上以 184 FPS 达到 62.3% 的 LaSOT AUC，在 Raspberry Pi 5 CPU 上为 96 FPS**，NPU 速度分别是 HiT-Tiny 和 AsymTrack-T 的 3.0 倍和 3.5 倍且精度更高。TaCo-B 在 NPU 上以 50 FPS 达到 65.6%，速度是 HiT-Base、AsymTrack-B 和 LightFC-vit 的两倍以上，精度同样更高。代码和模型见 https://github.com/TsingWei/TaCo-Tracker。
papers.abstract_en: Lightweight trackers have replaced cross-correlation with attention, and on low-power edge hardware they pay for it, since memory-bound softmax, normalization and reshaping operators of attention cost far more time than their arithmetic suggests. Benchmarking efficient trackers on an edge Neural Processing Unit (NPU) and an Arm CPU under one numerically validated protocol, we find that correlation trackers are the fast ones, but they lag in accuracy unless they adopt a ViT backbone, which brings attention back. We revisit what correlation lacks. Template--search interaction serves two roles: conditioning the search features on the target and matching them against it spatially. Attention does both, whereas correlation only matches, and does so on features extracted without knowledge of the target. We present TaCo (Target-aligned Correlation), which supplies the missing conditioning without attention by letting the template enter the per-frame network only as operands computed once per video. A descriptor of the target scales and shifts the search features channel by channel inside the backbone, and kernels aligned with the target box, each with a weight predicted from the template, correlate with them in one matrix product. With the backbone fixed, our correlation remains essential while incurring negligible NPU overhead, offering a better speed-accuracy trade-off than the attention-based interactions we tested. TaCo-T achieves 62.3% LaSOT AUC at 184 FPS on the Rockchip RV1126B NPU and 96 FPS on a Raspberry Pi 5 CPU, 3.0x and 3.5x the NPU speed of HiT-Tiny and AsymTrack-T at higher accuracy. TaCo-B reaches 65.6% at 50 FPS on the NPU, more than twice the speed of HiT-Base, AsymTrack-B and LightFC-vit, again at higher accuracy. Code and models are available at https://github.com/TsingWei/TaCo-Tracker.

papers.title: Linear-Time Online Visual Geometry Transformer with Hybrid Architecture
papers.title_zh: 采用混合架构的线性时间在线视觉几何 Transformer
papers.summary_zh: 用 Mamba2 与稀疏注意力混合架构实现常数延迟的在线三维重建。
papers.abstract_zh: VGGT 和 π^3 等基于 Transformer 的 3D 重建模型可以直接从多个输入视图预测相机、深度和点图。StreamVGGT 等因果注意力模型把它们扩展到在线视频，但会缓存所有过去的 token，因此总计算量随流长度二次增长。CUT3R 和 TTT3R 等循环模型保持固定大小的状态和恒定成本，但会逐渐遗忘早期的几何信息。我们提出 LinearVGGT，一个从 StreamVGGT 蒸馏而来的混合模型，在每四个全局层中的三个使用 Mamba2 层进行高效序列建模。其余层使用由 register 引导的稀疏注意力来检索少量相关的过去帧，以弥补 Mamba2 精确长程召回能力的不足。我们的蒸馏只需要 StreamVGGT 从 VGGT 学习时 9% 的 GPU 小时和 31% 的训练帧。LinearVGGT 在 1,024 帧上保持几乎恒定的每帧 27 ms 延迟，平均比 StreamVGGT 快 12 倍。它优于其教师模型，并与最先进的流式模型 LingBot-Map 相当，同时**速度快 2.5 倍，显存占用少 2.7 倍**。
papers.abstract_en: Transformer-based 3D reconstruction models such as VGGT and $π^3$ predict cameras, depth and point maps directly from many input views. Causal attention models such as StreamVGGT extend them to online video but cache all past tokens, so their total compute grows quadratically with the stream length. Recurrent models such as CUT3R and TTT3R keep a fixed-size state at constant cost, but they progressively forget early geometry. We present LinearVGGT, a hybrid model distilled from StreamVGGT, which uses Mamba2 layers for efficient sequence modeling in three of every four global layers. The remaining layers use register-guided sparse attention to retrieve a few relevant past frames, compensating for the limited exact long-range recall of Mamba2. Our distillation needs only 9\% of the GPU hours and 31\% of the training frames that StreamVGGT uses to learn from VGGT. LinearVGGT keeps an almost constant latency of 27 ms per frame over 1,024 frames and is on average $12 \times$ faster than StreamVGGT. It outperforms its teacher and is competitive with the state-of-the-art streaming model LingBot-Map, while running $2.5\times$ faster and using $2.7\times$ less memory.

papers.title: Partial Routing: Trace-Tuned Delegation for Resource-Efficient Agentic Workflows
papers.title_zh: 部分路由：面向资源高效智能体工作流的基于轨迹调优的委派
papers.summary_zh: 让前沿主模型把合适子任务委派给更便宜的工作模型，在降低成本的同时提升任务表现。
papers.abstract_zh: AI模型在能力和价格上差异巨大。模型路由通过把较简单的任务交给更便宜的模型来利用这一点。然而，单个智能体任务往往同时包含简单和困难的子任务，因此对整个任务只选一个模型是低效的。我们提出==部分路由==，引导一个前沿主模型把合适的子任务委派给更便宜的工作模型。我们从两个模型的历史运行中识别反复出现的子任务，并度量每个模型在这些子任务上的质量和成本。这些度量产生委派指导，其中参数 δ 控制委派的程度。主模型在执行过程中决定何时委派以及委派什么，无需训练任何一个模型。在ViBench和Terminal-Bench 4.0的留出任务上，部分路由的平均任务表现高于单独使用主模型以及任务级路由。取 δ=0.75 时，它把主模型的ViBench得分从70.2提升到78.5，**成本降低19%**，并把其Terminal-Bench通过率从54%提升到61%，成本相近。仅向主模型提供子任务拆分而不使用工作模型，同样在两个基准上降低了成本，并提高了Terminal-Bench通过率。这些结果表明，对历史运行的分析能够支持更高效的规划和更有效的委派，且开销与实现成本很低。
papers.abstract_en: AI models vary enormously in capability and price. Model routing exploits this by sending easier tasks to cheaper models. However, a single agentic task often combines easy and difficult subtasks, making one model choice for the entire task inefficient. We introduce partial routing, which guides a frontier lead model to delegate suitable subtasks to a cheaper worker model. From both models' past runs, we identify recurring subtasks and measure each model's quality and cost on them. These measurements produce delegation guidance, with a parameter, $δ$, controlling how much is delegated. The lead decides when and what to delegate during execution, without training either model. On held-out tasks from ViBench and Terminal-Bench 4.0, partial routing achieves higher mean task performance than the lead alone and task-level routing. With $δ= 0.75$, it raises the lead's ViBench score from 70.2 to 78.5 at 19% lower cost, and its Terminal-Bench pass rate from 54% to 61% at similar cost. Giving the lead only the subtask breakdown, without a worker, also reduces cost on both benchmarks and raises the Terminal-Bench pass rate. These results show that analysis of past runs can support more efficient planning and more effective delegation, with little cost and implementation overhead.

papers.title: FasterGRN: Reducing the Refinement Redundancy for Accelerating Generative Refinement Networks
papers.title_zh: FasterGRN：减少精修冗余以加速生成式精修网络
papers.summary_zh: 免训练地缩减 GRN 的精修步数与 token 计算，采样加速约 2 倍。
papers.abstract_zh: 生成式精修网络（GRN）不同于扩散和自回归模型，通过迭代精修实现高质量图像生成。然而对整个视觉表征的反复处理带来了大量计算开销。此外，GRN 的二值表征和全局精修机制使得为其他生成模型开发的加速策略无法直接应用。为加速 GRN，我们先通过分析整个生成过程观察到几个关键性质，包括阶段特性、双分支相似性，以及更重要的==精修冗余==。基于这些观察，我们提出 FasterGRN，一种面向 GRN 的免训练加速方法。FasterGRN 先根据语义建立情况把 GRN 划分为语义建立阶段与细节精修阶段。为缓解主要来自细节精修阶段的精修冗余，我们分别提出自适应保留扩展（ARE）和选择性 token 冻结（STF），以缩减精修步数并减少 token 计算。在 GenEval 和 DPG-Bench 上的实验中，我们的方法 FasterGRN 在基本保持图像生成性能的同时**实现 2.03 倍的采样加速**。在 COCO 上的评估还表明，FasterGRN 的图像保真度甚至优于原始 GRN。
papers.abstract_en: Departing from the paradigm of diffusion and autoregressive models, Generative Refinement Networks (GRN) enables high-quality image generation through iterative refinements. However, this repeated processing over the entire visual representations results in substantial computation overhead. Furthermore, the binary representations and global refinement mechanism in GRN disable the direct application of acceleration strategies developed for other generative models. To accelerate GRN model, we first observe several key properties by analyzing the entire generative process. That includes the stage characteristic, dual branch similarity and more importantly, the $\textbf{refinement redundancy}$. Motivated by the observations, we present $\textbf{FasterGRN}$, a training-free acceleration method for the Generative Refinement Network. $\textbf{FasterGRN}$ first divides the GRN into the semantic establishment stage and detail refinement stage according to its semantic establishment. For alleviating the refinement redundancy mainly resulting from the detail refinement stage, we propose Adaptive Retention Expansion ($\textbf{ARE}$) and Selective Token Freezing ($\textbf{STF}$) to shrink refinement steps and reduce token computations, respectively. In the experiments on GenEval and DPG-Bench benchmarks, our method $\textbf{FasterGRN}$ achieves a $2.03\times$ sampling speedup while largely preserving image generation performance. Our evaluation on COCO datasets additionally demonstrates that $\textbf{FasterGRN}$ even outperforms the original GRN in image fidelity.

papers.title: Mixture-of-Loops Transformer
papers.title_zh: Mixture-of-Loops Transformer
papers.summary_zh: 用KV复用的循环Transformer提升token效率并保持推理延迟
papers.abstract_zh: 循环Transformer通过跨循环复用共享层来提升表达能力，但代价是效率。要推进其表达能力与效率的前沿，需要重新思考连接相邻循环的核心机制：Transformer循环时应当传递什么？我们提出Mixture-of-Loops Transformer（MoLT），其Mixture-of-Loops Attention（MoLA）将键值（KV）作为记忆，在跨深度和跨循环时选择性复用。在循环残差设定下，MoLT-R保留残差流并读取跨循环的局部KV以保证表达能力；在循环KV设定下，MoLT-KV则从嵌入重新开始，在较早位置读取当前循环的局部KV和前序循环的记忆KV以提升效率。MoLT-KV消除了同位置的跨循环依赖，配合用于并行训练的循环强制（loop forcing），使得单次遍历的Mixture-of-Loops（MoL）解码可以超出训练循环范围。为平衡效率与质量，我们提出U形MoLT（U-MoLT），它将记忆构建与预测读出分离，并在不改变预测的前提下跳过未使用的解码器遍历。在400B token的预训练中，U-MoLT在700M/1.5B稠密模型和3B MoE模型上均优于OLMo3，在700M规模上达到==1.7倍的验证交叉熵（CE）token效率==，同时将3B MoE的10个领域困惑度改善0.75，10项任务准确率提高2.1个百分点。在Qwen3.5-0.8B-Base的100B token持续预训练中，我们的U-MoLT适配在全部11个领域上CE均低于匹配基线，平均token效率为1.4倍。推理时，采用MoL-Hybrid-2的U-MoLT在S规模（约113M）模型上与非循环OLMo3延迟持平，为**996.6 ms对1,000.6 ms**。代码见 https://github.com/hustvl/MoLT
papers.abstract_en: Looped Transformers boost expressivity by reusing shared layers across loops, yet at the cost of efficiency. Pushing their expressivity-efficiency frontier requires rethinking the core mechanism connecting adjacent loops: What should be passed as a Transformer loops? We introduce Mixture-of-Loops Transformer (MoLT), whose Mixture-of-Loops Attention (MoLA) uses keys and values (KV) as memory for selective reuse across depths and loops. Under loop residual, MoLT-R retains the residual stream and reads local KV across loops for expressivity. Under loop KV, MoLT-KV instead restarts from embeddings and reads current-loop local KV with preceding-loop memory KV at earlier positions for efficiency. MoLT-KV eliminates same-position cross-loop dependence and, paired with loop forcing for parallel training, unlocks single-traversal Mixture-of-Loops (MoL) decoding beyond the training loop horizon. To balance efficiency and quality, we introduce U-shaped MoLT (U-MoLT), which separates memory construction from prediction readout and skips unused decoder traversals without changing predictions. In 400B-token pretraining, U-MoLT outperforms OLMo3 across 700M/1.5B dense and 3B MoE models, achieving 1.7x validation cross-entropy (CE) token efficiency at 700M while improving 3B MoE 10-domain perplexity by 0.75 and 10-task accuracy by 2.1 percentage points. In 100B-token continued pretraining of Qwen3.5-0.8B-Base, our U-MoLT adaptation lowers CE on all 11 domains over the matched baseline with 1.4x mean token efficiency. At inference, U-MoLT with MoL-Hybrid-2 matches non-looped OLMo3 latency at 996.6 vs. 1,000.6 ms on S-size (~113M) models. Code is available at https://github.com/hustvl/MoLT

papers.title: Collect for Coverage, Replay with Evidence: Adaptive and Efficient On-Policy Distillation for Long-Horizon Agents
papers.title_zh: 为覆盖而收集，凭证据而回放：面向长程智能体的自适应高效在策略蒸馏
papers.summary_zh: 改进前缀回放的在策略蒸馏，缩短长程智能体训练时间
papers.abstract_zh: 完全在线的在策略蒸馏（OPD）对长程智能体来说代价高昂，因为每次更新都依赖新鲜的环境rollout。前缀回放提供了一种高效替代：从存储的历史中采样当前学生模型的回复，减少长尾rollout的空闲时间，并使每条收集的轨迹支持多次更新。然而，我们对完整前缀回放流程的分析发现了长程场景下的两个局限。在轨迹收集上，只含教师的轨迹会遗漏学生诱导产生的历史，而扩大历史覆盖又会降低教师的可靠性；在轨迹复用上，固定的按位置调度无法识别可能出现在任意轨迹深度的关键决策。我们提出CARE-OPD（Collect for coverAge, Replay with Evidence）来解决这两个问题。==学生播种的教师补全==与回复级置信度门控在扩大历史覆盖的同时过滤不可靠的更新，随后==事后回放分配==利用下游执行证据选择有影响的轮次。在软件工程和深度研究这两类长程任务上，CARE-OPD优于在线OPD和已有前缀回放基线。在SWE-bench Verified上，它将任务成功率提高到59.5%，相对异步在线OPD**端到端训练时间减少45%，环境动作减少44%**。
papers.abstract_en: Fully online on-policy distillation (OPD) is costly for long-horizon agents because each update depends on fresh environment rollouts. Prefix replay offers an efficient alternative by sampling current-student responses from stored histories, reducing idle time for long-tail rollouts and allowing each collected trajectory to support multiple updates. However, our analysis of the complete prefix replay pipeline identifies two limitations in long-horizon settings. In trajectory collection, teacher-only trajectories miss student-induced histories, while broader history coverage can reduce teacher reliability. In trajectory reuse, fixed position-based schedules cannot identify critical decisions that may occur at any trajectory depth. We introduce CARE-OPD (Collect for coverAge, Replay with Evidence) to address both limitations. Student-seeded teacher completions and response-level confidence gating expand history coverage while filtering unreliable updates. Hindsight replay allocation then uses downstream execution evidence to select consequential turns. Across long-horizon tasks Software Engineering and Deep Research, CARE-OPD outperforms online OPD and prior prefix replay baselines. On SWE-bench Verified, it raises task success to 59.5% while reducing end-to-end training time by 45% and environment actions by 44% relative to asynchronous online OPD.

papers.title: DecisionReplay: A Corpus and Offline Simulator for Ensembling Decision Models
papers.title_zh: DecisionReplay：用于集成决策模型的语料库与离线模拟器
papers.summary_zh: 发布17个商用模型的概率向量与成本数据，离线模拟集成、路由和级联。
papers.abstract_zh: 比较集成、路由器和级联方法，需要每个模型在每个条目上的输出及其成本。为路由构建的现有数据集合并不保存每个选项的概率。我们提供了一个数据集，可以在无需新模型调用的情况下快速模拟集成方法、路由器和级联。==DecisionReplay== 收录了17个商用决策模型（对每个答案选项都返回概率的端点）在35个基准上的概率向量，以及每次调用的 token 数、计费成本和实测延迟，全部公开。一个确定性模拟器可以重放任何选择、组合或级联这些模型的策略。**每个基准上只选一个合适的模型很难被超越：汇集所有模型比它低2.7个精度点，堆叠只多1.0个点却要花3.4倍的成本。**模型们会一起犯错：两个都答错的模型有72%的情况会选同一个错误选项。最好的路由器以其64%的成本达到该模型的水平，而经过认证的提前退出能在不改变任何答案的情况下把堆叠集成的成本降低43%。DecisionReplay 让人们能低成本、快速地检验新方法是否会改变这些结果。
papers.abstract_en: Comparing ensembles, routers and cascades requires the output of every model on every item, and its cost. Stored collections built for routing keep no per-option probabilities. We provide a dataset on which ensemble methods, routers and cascades are simulated quickly, without new model calls. DecisionReplay holds the probability vectors of 17 commercial decision models, endpoints that return a probability for every answer option, on 35 benchmarks, with the token counts, billed cost and measured latency of every call, all released. A deterministic simulator replays any policy that selects, combines or cascades them. One well-chosen model per benchmark is hard to beat: pooling all models loses 2.7 accuracy points to it, and stacking gains 1.0 points at 3.4 times its cost. The models are wrong together: two that are both wrong choose the same wrong option in 72% of cases. The best router matches that model at 64% of its cost, and certified early exit cuts the cost of a stacked ensemble by 43% without changing an answer. DecisionReplay makes it cheap and fast to test whether a new method changes these results.

papers.title: Same Seed, Different Top Prediction: Cross-Platform Reproducibility of AlphaFold 3 Inference on TPUs, GPUs, and CPUs
papers.title_zh: 同一种子，不同的最优预测：AlphaFold 3 推理在 TPU、GPU 与 CPU 上的跨平台可复现性
papers.summary_zh: 测量AlphaFold 3推理在不同加速器间返回结构不一致的频率，并给出一致性建议。
papers.abstract_zh: AlphaFold 3 会返回若干采样结构中排名最高的一个，且每次预测都在单一设备上计算。计算中心可能把任务调度到不同型号的 GPU 或 CPU 节点上。不同设备的浮点结果可能不同，因此相同输入和种子也可能返回另一个结构。AlphaFold 3 的文档和输出对此都没有任何提示。我们测量了设备对返回结构的影响频率，并告诉用户应报告什么、如何让不同设备结果一致。我们在两代 Google 张量处理器（TPU v5e、v6e）、三种 NVIDIA GPU（L4、A100、H100）和一颗 Intel Xeon CPU 上，使用相同的输入、权重、种子和设置。在 60 个蛋白-配体复合物、每个五个种子的实验中，==切换 TPU 代际==使 300 次预测中 **18.0% 的最优样本发生改变**。在两种 TPU 上重新编译从未改变结果，但在 L4 GPU 上改变了 7.3%。然而结构本身几乎没有移动：排名最高的构象在正确与错误之间切换的比例为 3.3% 至 3.7%，而更换一个新种子约为 10%。这些切换几乎都来自同一项有效性检查，即配体位于 2 埃以内。后续实验在 72 个新靶标上以及 TPU 与 CPU 之间再次发现该效应。在 A100 与 H100 之间，该效应超过了重新编译带来的差异，尽管 AlphaFold 3 的开发者已在这两种设备上验证过其数值精度。一项探索性分析将这些变化与接近并列的候选样本联系起来。我们建议报告所用设备以及所有接近并列的样本。==float32 主干网络配合全精度矩阵乘法==可让五种加速器在几乎所有预测上取得一致。
papers.abstract_en: AlphaFold 3 returns the highest-ranked of several sampled structures and computes each prediction on one device. Computing centers may schedule them on different GPU types or CPU nodes. Floating-point results can differ between devices, so the same input and seed may return another structure. Neither AlphaFold 3's documentation nor its outputs warn of this. We measure how often the device changes the returned structure, and tell users what to report and how to make devices agree. We used identical inputs, weights, seeds, and settings on two Google tensor processing unit (TPU) generations (v5e, v6e), three NVIDIA GPUs (L4, A100, H100), and an Intel Xeon CPU. On 60 protein-ligand complexes, with five seeds each, switching TPU generations changed the top-ranked sample in 18.0% of 300 predictions. Recompiling never changed it on either TPU, but did so in 7.3% on the L4 GPU. Yet the structures barely moved. The top-ranked pose switched between correct and incorrect in 3.3% to 3.7% of predictions, against about 10% for a new seed. These switches nearly always came from one validity check, with the ligand within 2 angstroms. Follow-ups found the effect again on 72 new targets and between the TPUs and the CPU. Between the A100 and H100 it exceeded recompilation, although AlphaFold 3's developers verified its numerical accuracy on both. An exploratory analysis links the changes to near-tied candidates.
