We recommend reporting the device and every near-tied sample. A float32 trunk with full-precision matrix products made all five accelerators agree on nearly every prediction.

papers.title: MeterRouter: Budget-Aware Dynamic Routing for Multi-Agent Systems
papers.title_zh: MeterRouter：面向多智能体系统的预算感知动态路由
papers.summary_zh: 按每个查询的费用预算动态选择智能体角色、LLM与拓扑，降低多智能体系统成本。
papers.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统（MAS）优于单智能体系统，但智能体之间的通信会带来大量 token 开销。为每个智能体都分配大型 LLM 是常见做法，但这会造成资源利用低效，使系统远离帕累托前沿。回答一个查询的成本由招募的智能体数量、每个智能体的角色与 LLM，以及它们之间的通信拓扑共同决定。现有路由器大多只是隐式地处理成本，而不是把它作为显式的优化约束。固定的精度-成本偏好也无法表达调用方愿意为某个特定查询支付多少。我们提出 ==MeterRouter==，一种预算感知的动态路由器，它根据查询和每个查询的费用预算，逐步合成协作图，选择每个智能体的角色、LLM、入边连接和终止条件。我们先通过模仿成功的执行图来初始化路由器，再用 GRPO 的一个变体联合优化其决策，其奖励鼓励正确答案，并惩罚花费和超出预算。在五个基准和三档 LLM 池上，MeterRouter 具有三个特点：（1）准确，性能与最强的 MAS 相当；（2）经济，达到同等精度时**成本比最强的 MAS 路由器低 82%**，并将精度-成本前沿扩展到单智能体系统的上限之外；（3）可控，能根据指定预算调整花费且很少超出预算。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent systems (MAS) built on large language models (LLMs) outperform single-agent systems, but inter-agent communication incurs substantial token overhead. While assigning a large LLM to every agent is common, it results in inefficient resource utilization, leaving the system far from the Pareto frontier. The cost of answering a query is set jointly by how many agents are recruited, the role and LLM assigned to each, and communication topology among them. Most existing routers treat cost only implicitly rather than as an explicit optimization constraint. A fixed accuracy-cost preference also cannot express how much a caller is willing to pay for a particular query. We introduce MeterRouter, a budget-aware dynamic router that incrementally synthesizes a collaboration graph by selecting each agent's role, LLM, incoming connections, and termination conditioned on the query and a per-query monetary budget. We initialize the router by imitating successful execution graphs, then jointly refine its decisions with a variant of Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) whose reward favors correct answers and penalizes spending and budget overruns. Across five benchmarks and a three-tier LLM pool, MeterRouter is (1) accurate, achieving performance comparable to the strongest MAS; (2) economical, reaching that accuracy at 82% lower cost than the strongest MAS router and extending the accuracy-cost frontier beyond the ceiling of single-agent systems; and (3) controllable, adapting its spending to the specified budget while rarely exceeding it.

papers.title: JOVE ICE: Intent Guided Cloud Edge Device Collaboration for AI Glasses
papers.title_zh: JOVE ICE：面向 AI 眼镜的意图引导云边端协同
papers.summary_zh: 按用户意图在眼镜、手机和云端间路由请求，降低首 token 时间与 token 用量。
papers.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）及基于 LLM 的智能体拓展了 AI 眼镜的能力，使其可以做第一视角视觉问答、记忆检索和主动协助。这些应用涉及语音、图像和视频等多样输入，任务从简单的设备控制到复杂的视觉推理，对计算和通信效率提出了挑战。视频类能力已受到较多关注，但简单的文本类和设备可执行任务虽然在日常交互中很常见，却研究不足。如何在统一助手中高效支持多样负载仍是开放问题。我们提出 ==JOVE ICE==，一个意图引导的云、边、端协同框架，根据用户意图在 AI 眼镜、配对手机和云服务器之间路由请求。JOVE ICE 将分层意图分类与动态子智能体编排结合，以选择高效的执行路径，并通过专用子智能体灵活接入新应用。对真实 AI 眼镜请求的分析显示，简单设备控制任务占交互的 30% 以上，JOVE ICE 直接在设备端处理这类任务，避免不必要的云端计算和成本。在三个公开基准上的评测表明，与传统的设备端和云端架构相比，JOVE ICE 在保持任务质量的同时，**首 token 时间降低约 13%，token 用量减少超过 11%**。这些结果说明意图引导的协同有望提升 AI 眼镜的效率和可扩展性。
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) and LLM based agents have expanded the capabilities of AI glasses, enabling egocentric visual question answering, memory retrieval, and proactive assistance. These applications involve diverse inputs, including speech, images, and video, and range from simple device control to complex visual reasoning, posing challenges for efficient computation and communication. While video centric capabilities have received considerable attention, simple text based and device executable tasks remain underexplored despite their prevalence in daily interactions. Efficiently supporting diverse workloads within a unified assistant remains an open challenge. We propose JOVE ICE, an intent guided cloud, edge, and device collaborative framework that routes requests among AI glasses, a paired smartphone, and cloud servers according to user intent. JOVE ICE integrates hierarchical intent classification with dynamic subagent orchestration to select efficient execution paths and flexibly incorporate new applications through specialized subagents. Analysis of real world AI glasses requests reveals that simple device control tasks account for over 30% of interactions, which JOVE ICE handles directly on device to avoid unnecessary cloud computation and costs. Evaluations on three public benchmarks demonstrate that JOVE ICE reduces time to first token by approximately 13% and token usage by over 11% compared with conventional device and cloud architectures, while maintaining task quality. These results demonstrate the potential of intent guided collaboration to improve the efficiency and scalability of AI glasses.

papers.title: State Space Attention: Learning Context-Dependent Memory Retention
papers.title_zh: 状态空间注意力：学习上下文相关的记忆保留
papers.summary_zh: 学习保留有界的过往表示并用标准注意力读取，实现恒定推理内存。
papers.abstract_zh: 标准注意力的键值缓存随上下文长度线性增长。为其设置上界就带来一个问题：长上下文推理中序列模型应该保留什么。我们认为这一选择应当通过学习获得，并提出 ==State Space Attention（SSA）==，它学习保留一个有界的过往表示集合，并用标准注意力读取。一个学习得到的打分器把每个块与新到达的上下文以及其余记忆重新打分。固定上下文的 Transformer 则是始终保留最近 token 的特例。我们联合训练打分器和读取器，或者从可微的软加权记忆逐步过渡到硬保留，或者一开始就使用硬保留。为给打分器提供信号，我们在训练中生成监督样本，称为 recovery。我们在检索、变量追踪、多跳推理和语言建模上，将 SSA 与循环模型、有界记忆注意力方法和全注意力 Transformer 比较。在我们的检索和推理基准上，SSA 在大多数任务中与全注意力持平或仅差几个点，在每个长上下文检索任务上都**远超相同可读预算的 Transformer，并与约 4 倍预算的 Transformer 持平或更好**，同时推理内存恒定。在小语言模型规模上，与全注意力最大的剩余差距出现在 RULER 上。SSA 让固定数量的 token 在更长上下文中发挥作用，且因为它用标准注意力读取记忆，我们提出它可以与 KV 缓存驱逐方法叠加使用。我们还预训练并后训练了 400M 参数的模型，测量 SSA 的训练和推理成本如何随上下文长度和模型规模变化。这些实验共同考察了学习式记忆保留在长上下文序列建模中的能力与局限。
papers.abstract_en: Standard attention's key-value cache grows linearly with context length. Bounding it raises the question of what a sequence model should retain for long-context reasoning. We argue this choice should be learned, and introduce State Space Attention (SSA), which learns to keep a bounded set of past representations and reads them with standard attention. A learned scorer rescores every chunk against newly arriving context and the rest of memory. A fixed-context Transformer is then the special case that always keeps the most recent tokens. We train the scorer and reader jointly, either moving gradually from a differentiable soft weighting of memories to hard retention, or with hard retention from the start. To produce signal for the scorer, we generate supervised samples during training, a technique we call recovery. We compare SSA with recurrent models, bounded-memory attention methods, and full-attention Transformers across retrieval, variable tracking, multi-hop reasoning, and language modeling. On our retrieval and reasoning benchmarks, SSA matches or comes within a few points of full attention on most tasks, far outperforms a Transformer with the same readable budget on every long-context retrieval task we evaluate, and matches or outperforms one with about 4 times that budget, while using constant inference memory. The largest remaining gap to full attention at small language model scale is on RULER. SSA makes a fixed number of tokens useful over a longer context, and since it reads memory with standard attention, we propose that it can be stacked with KV cache eviction methods. We also pretrain and post-train 400M-parameter models and measure how SSA's training and inference costs scale with context length and model size. Together, these experiments examine the capabilities and limitations of learned memory retention for long-context sequence modeling.

papers.title: Spe3DUp: Faithful Trajectory Distillation for Fast Image-to-3D Generation
papers.title_zh: Spe3DUp：面向快速图像到三维生成的忠实轨迹蒸馏
papers.summary_zh: 用忠实轨迹蒸馏压缩 3D 生成的采样步数，端到端提速 7.7 倍。
papers.abstract_zh: 近期的 3D 生成模型可以生成带有复杂结构和精细几何细节的高质量网格，在游戏、影视和数字设计中应用广泛。然而高质量生成通常依赖需要反复调用大型网络的长多步采样过程，导致推理时间很长。同时，游戏资产重建和产品数字化等以参考为驱动的任务要求与输入图像高度对应：生成的几何必须忠实还原特定的参考物体。因此，加速必须在减少采样计算的同时保留模型重建该物体的能力。为实现快速且忠实的 3D 生成，我们提出 Spe3DUp，一个基于==忠实轨迹蒸馏==（FTD）的由粗到细框架。FTD 直接用教师模型以输入为条件的去噪轨迹来监督少步学生模型，以保留其生成行为。我们把 FTD 分别用于粗几何生成和几何精修，在保持与参考输入对应的同时压缩这两个采样过程。我们还通过高效的几何解码与并行重网格化来加速整个网格生成流水线。实验表明，Spe3DUp 的几何质量和与输入的对应程度接近教师模型，粗生成与精修两个 DiT 分别加速 10.0 倍和 19.9 倍，**相对原始教师流水线端到端加速 7.7 倍**。
papers.abstract_en: Recent 3D generative models can produce high-quality meshes with complex structures and fine geometric details, with broad applications in games, film, and digital design. However, high-quality generation typically relies on long multi-step sampling processes that repeatedly evaluate large networks, leading to long inference times. At the same time, reference-driven tasks such as game-asset reconstruction and product digitization demand close correspondence to the input image: generated geometry must faithfully reconstruct the specific reference object. Acceleration must therefore reduce sampling computation while preserving the model's ability to reconstruct that object. To enable fast and faithful 3D generation, we introduce Spe3DUp, a coarse-to-fine framework based on Faithful Trajectory Distillation (FTD). FTD directly supervises few-step students with the teacher's input-conditioned denoising trajectories to preserve its generation behavior. We apply FTD separately to coarse geometry generation and geometric refinement, compressing both sampling processes while maintaining correspondence to the reference input. We further accelerate the complete mesh-generation pipeline with efficient geometry decoding and parallel remeshing. Experiments show that Spe3DUp maintains geometric quality and input correspondence close to those of the teacher, accelerates the coarse and refinement DiTs by 10.0x and 19.9x, respectively, and achieves a 7.7x end-to-end speedup over the original teacher pipeline.

papers.title: Maco-RL: Scaling Agent Capabilities with Mixed-Task Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: Maco-RL：用混合任务强化学习扩展 Agent 能力
papers.summary_zh: 用配额式异步 rollout 调度和三缓冲采样做混合任务 RL 后训练。
papers.abstract_zh: 混合任务强化学习（MixRL）直接在多个领域上训练统一策略，无需训练各自的专家模型，也无需额外的蒸馏阶段，从而持续扩展 Agent 能力。但扩展 MixRL 面临几项挑战：实现稳定高效的混合任务学习、有效分配 rollout 计算量，以及支持持续的领域扩展。为此我们提出 Maco-RL，一种有效扩展 MixRL 的方法。具体来说，Maco-RL 采用基于配额的调度器，在多个任务领域上异步执行 rollout，通过平衡梯度贡献并缓解 off-policy 效应来稳定训练。与此正交，Maco-RL 还引入三缓冲采样（Tri-Buffer Sampling，TBS），在掌握程度不同的样本之间分配计算量，在保持已有能力的同时促进持续的前沿探索。在五个基准上的实验表明，==Maco-RL== 将 Qwen3.5-27B 的总体得分从 43.6 提升到 54.2，持续扩展后进一步提升到 60.1，达到 Qwen3.8-27B 所处的前沿水平，并将其再向外推进 +5.7。**Maco-RL 用更少的策略更新计算量就超过了单任务 RL。**这些结果表明，MixRL 是一种实用且计算高效的后训练方法，在增强通用 Agent 能力方面潜力巨大。
papers.abstract_en: Mixed-task reinforcement learning (MixRL) directly trains a unified policy across domains to continually expand agent capabilities without training separate specialists or requiring an extra distillation stage. Despite its appeal, scaling MixRL poses significant challenges in achieving stable and efficient mixed-task learning, effectively allocating rollout compute, and supporting continual domain expansion. To address these challenges, we propose Maco-RL, an approach that effectively scales MixRL. Specifically, Maco-RL employs a quota-based scheduler for asynchronous rollouts across multiple task domains, thereby stabilizing training by balancing gradient contributions and mitigating off-policy effects. Along an orthogonal axis, Maco-RL further introduces Tri-Buffer Sampling (TBS) to allocate compute among samples with varying levels of mastery, promoting sustained frontier exploration while preserving acquired capabilities. Experiments on five benchmarks show Maco-RL raises Qwen3.5-27B's overall score from 43.6 to 54.2 and then to 60.1 with continual expansion, reaching the frontier held by Qwen3.8-27B, which is further pushed outward by +5.7. Maco-RL also outperforms single-task RL with less compute for policy updates. These results support MixRL as a practical and compute-efficient post-training approach with substantial potential to strengthen general agent capabilities.

papers.title: Learning to Be Truncated: Preparing LLM Checkpoints for SVD Compression
papers.title_zh: 学会被截断：为 SVD 压缩准备 LLM 检查点
papers.summary_zh: 用一次微调让模型在多种压缩率下做 SVD 截断时无需再微调。
papers.abstract_zh: 基于奇异值分解（SVD）的压缩通常需要后续微调或权重修正来缓解性能下降，而且针对不同压缩率需要重复进行特定预算的优化。我们提出 ==LLift==，它无需进一步微调，就能让预训练模型为跨压缩率的 SVD 压缩做好准备。LLift 以原始模型作教师，在单一压缩率下微调一个低秩近似；随后把学到的更新合并回原始权重，同时保留训练前向中被排除的互补成分。之后对准备好的模型的目标矩阵做 SVD，并在不同截断秩下复用这些分解。在 LLaMA-7B 上，**我们用同一个准备好的模型，在三种压缩率下都取得了精度提升**。这些增益可推广到不同模型家族、模型规模和 SVD 压缩算子。我们还分析了梯度和早期训练更新，为在一个压缩率下学到的更新可惠及其他压缩率提供了局部证据。这些结果表明，LLift 能在不同部署预算下改进压缩效果，而无需对每个压缩后的模型分别微调。
papers.abstract_en: Compression based on singular value decomposition (SVD) often requires subsequent fine-tuning or weight correction to mitigate performance degradation. Budget-specific optimization must be repeated for different compression ratios. We introduce LLift, which prepares a pretrained model for SVD compression across ratios without further fine-tuning. LLift fine-tunes a low-rank approximation at a single ratio using the original model as a teacher. We merge the learned updates into the original weights while preserving the complementary components excluded from the training forward pass. We apply SVD to the prepared model's target matrices and reuse the decompositions at different truncation ranks. On LLaMA-7B, we demonstrate accuracy gains across three compression ratios using a single prepared model. The gains extend across model families, model sizes, and SVD compression operators. We analyze gradients and an early training update to provide local evidence that updates learned at one ratio can benefit compression at other ratios. These results show that LLift can improve compression across deployment budgets without fine-tuning each compressed model separately.

papers.title: PURA: Video Token Pruning via Unified Spatiotemporal Redundancy Assessment
papers.title_zh: PURA：通过统一时空冗余评估的视频 Token 剪枝
papers.summary_zh: 免训练地统一评估时空冗余，为视频大模型剪枝视觉 token。
papers.abstract_zh: 视频大语言模型因长视觉 token 序列而产生可观的推理成本。现有视频 token 压缩方法利用帧内的空间冗余和帧间的时间冗余来降低成本，但许多方法采用预定义的处理顺序或固定的空间/时间压缩比例，难以适应不同视频中时空冗余的不同平衡。为此我们提出 PURA，一种免训练的方法，通过==统一的时空冗余评估==来剪枝视觉 token。对每个 token，PURA 构造空间和时间两种参考候选，并选出在两个维度上表示误差最低的参考；表示误差与 token 重要性结合，决定每个 token 的移除代价。为避免逐个移除最低代价 token 的时间开销，我们引入==协调剪枝==，迭代地把相互兼容的低代价移除分组成批同时执行，并在每批之后更新剪枝状态，直到达到目标预算。在三个视频大语言模型和五个视频理解基准上的大量实验表明，**PURA 在任务性能与推理效率之间取得了良好的折中。**
papers.abstract_en: Video large language models incur substantial inference costs from long visual token sequences. Existing video token compression methods mitigate these costs by exploiting spatial redundancy within frames and temporal redundancy across frames. However, many approaches impose predefined processing orders or fixed allocation ratios for spatial and temporal compression, limiting their ability to adapt to the varying balance of spatiotemporal redundancy across videos. To address this limitation, we propose PURA, a training-free method that prunes visual tokens through unified spatiotemporal redundancy assessment. For each token, PURA constructs spatial and temporal reference candidates and selects the reference with the lowest representation error across the two dimensions. The representation error is combined with token importance to determine each token's removal cost. To avoid the time overhead of removing the lowest-cost token one by one, we introduce Coordinated Pruning, which iteratively groups mutually compatible low-cost removals into batches for simultaneous execution and updates the pruning state after each batch until the target budget is reached. Extensive experiments on three video large language models and five video understanding benchmarks demonstrate that PURA achieves a favorable trade-off between task performance and inference efficiency.

papers.title: DiCALM: Converting Autoregressive Convolution-Attention Language Models into Discrete Diffusion Language Models
papers.title_zh: DiCALM：将自回归卷积-注意力语言模型转换为离散扩散语言模型
papers.summary_zh: 把LFM2系列卷积-注意力混合模型从AR转为掩码扩散，350M和1.2B上平均加速1.4倍以上。
papers.abstract_zh: 现有将自回归（AR）语言模型适配为扩散生成的方法主要面向全注意力架构，而更高效的混合架构尚未得到充分探索。我们提出 ==DiCALM==，一套把 LFM2 系列（LFM2 与 LFM2.5）卷积-注意力混合模型从 AR 转换为掩码扩散生成的方案。DiCALM 逐步扩展 LFM2 的因果门控卷积，使其能捕获双向局部上下文，并将这一扩展与==掩码预热==及==AR-扩散联合训练==结合。在受控实验中，DiCALM 的表现与对应的微调后 LFM2.5 AR 模型相当，并在 350M 和 1.2B 两个规模上稳定带来加速，**平均超过 1.4 倍，最高达 1.79 倍**。
papers.abstract_en: Existing methods for adapting autoregressive (AR) language models to diffusion generation focus mainly on full-attention architectures. More efficient hybrid architectures remain underexplored. We introduce DiCALM, a recipe for converting the hybrid convolution-attention models of the LFM2 family (LFM2 and LFM2.5) from AR to masked-diffusion generation. DiCALM progressively extends LFM2's causal gated convolution so that it captures local context in both directions. It combines this extension with a masking warm-up and joint AR--diffusion training. In controlled experiments, DiCALM performs comparably to the corresponding fine-tuned LFM2.5-based AR models and delivers consistent speedups over them at both the 350M and 1.2B scales: over 1.4x on average and up to 1.79x.

papers.title: Faster and Better Query (FBQ): Learning Future-Position Probes from the First Generated Token
papers.title_zh: Faster and Better Query（FBQ）：从首个生成 token 学习未来位置探针
papers.summary_zh: 用首个输出 token 学习伪查询，为预填充后的 KV 缓存驱逐提供打分依据。
papers.abstract_zh: 当大语言模型（LLM）在预填充结束时驱逐提示词的键和值时，它必须在尚未看到后续解码步骤查询的情况下决定保留什么。生成一段草稿续写可以近似这些查询，但代价是额外的自回归步骤。能否利用最终预填充 logits 中已有的首个输出 token 的嵌入，以低成本构造伪查询来近似未来的解码查询？我们先从 FTQ-8 入手：把首个 token ID 的八份拷贝放在连续的未来位置，并在一次因果前向中读取它们对提示词的注意力。每份拷贝看到的前缀各不相同，但像 the 这样的通用开头对后续七个 token 来说是很差的字面猜测。==Faster and Better Query（FBQ）== 保留首个嵌入，并在其余七个位置各学习一个加性偏移。我们训练这些偏移去预测完整缓存续写的平均提示词注意力。在 LongBench 上，FBQ 在相同缓存预算下与八步 Lookahead Q-Cache 表现相当，且**只需一次前向即可计算全部探针查询**。
papers.abstract_en: When a large language model (LLM) evicts prompt keys and values at the end of prefill, it must decide what to keep before it sees the queries from subsequent decoding steps. Generating a draft continuation can approximate those queries at the cost of extra autoregressive steps. Can we use the embedding of the first output token, already available from the final prefill logits, to construct low-cost pseudo queries that approximate future decoding queries? We start with FTQ-8, which places eight copies of the first token ID at consecutive future positions and reads their attention to the prompt in one causal forward pass. Each copy sees a different prefix, but a generic opening such as the offers a poor literal guess for seven successive tokens. Faster and Better Query (FBQ) preserves the first embedding and learns an additive offset at each of the seven remaining positions. We train these offsets to predict the average prompt attention of a full-cache continuation. On LongBench, FBQ performs comparably to eight-step Lookahead Q-Cache at the same cache budget, using a single forward pass to compute all probe queries.

papers.title: What Is Redundant at High Resolution? Efficient Attention and Feed-Forward Design for All-in-One Image Restoration
papers.title_zh: 高分辨率下什么是冗余的？面向一体化图像复原的高效注意力与前馈设计
papers.summary_zh: 分析高分辨率阶段的冗余并设计高效图像复原网络 HiGLR。
papers.abstract_zh: 多尺度架构被广泛用于一体化图像复原（AIO-IR），在低分辨率阶段捕获更大尺度的上下文，在高分辨率（HR）阶段细化细节。然而，在 HR 阶段处理空间上很大的特征图会带来可观的计算开销和访存流量，使高效的 HR 处理很有挑战。为此，我们提出 ==HiGLR（High-resolution Global-Local Restoration）==，一种高效的多尺度 AIO-IR 网络，其基础是对自注意力和卷积前馈网络（ConvFFN）中空间冗余的分析。分析识别出三类关键冗余：最精细尺度阶段的逐查询读出、中间阶段相邻查询间的键路由，以及 ConvFFN 扩展特征空间中的空间混合。据此，HiGLR 在最精细尺度阶段用学习到的与输入无关的核替代代价高昂的自注意力；在中间阶段提出 Block-Routed Hybrid Attention，将粗尺度稠密注意力与基于相对粗摘要的值残差的细尺度块稀疏注意力结合，并在相邻查询间共享路由索引；我们还提出 Dual-Space FFN，在紧凑空间中做空间混合，在扩展空间中做逐点非线性变换，从而实现高效的 kernel 融合。结合这些设计，HiGLR 在取得最先进性能的同时，相比现有方法**推理加速最高达 4.24 倍**。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-scale architectures are widely adopted in all-in-one image restoration (AIO-IR) to capture larger-scale context at low-resolution stages and refine details at high-resolution (HR) stages. However, processing spatially large feature maps at HR stages incurs substantial computational costs and memory traffic, making efficient HR processing challenging. To address this challenge, we propose High-resolution Global-Local Restoration (HiGLR), an efficient multi-scale AIO-IR network grounded in an analysis of spatial redundancy in self-attention and convolutional feed-forward networks (ConvFFNs). Specifically, this analysis identifies three key redundancies: per-query readout at the finest-scale stage, key routing across neighboring queries at intermediate stages, and spatial mixing in the expanded feature spaces of ConvFFNs. Accordingly, HiGLR replaces costly self-attention at the finest-scale stage with a learned input-independent kernel. At intermediate stages, we propose a Block-Routed Hybrid Attention, which combines coarse-scale dense attention with fine-scale block-sparse attention over value residuals relative to coarse summaries, and shares routing indices across neighboring queries. We further introduce a Dual-Space FFN that performs spatial mixing in a compact space and pointwise nonlinear transformation in an expanded space, enabling efficient kernel fusion. Combining these designs, HiGLR achieves state-of-the-art performance while delivering up to a $4.24\times$ inference speedup over existing methods.

papers.title: Amortizing Exact Orthogonality: Drift-Triggered Restoration for Orthogonal Fine-Tuning
papers.title_zh: 摊销精确正交性：正交微调的漂移触发恢复
papers.summary_zh: 提出 RTOFT，仅在漂移达阈值时用极分解恢复正交性，降低正交微调开销。
papers.abstract_zh: 正交微调（OFT）通过正交变换来适配预训练权重，并保持其奇异值和行间夹角，但现有方法在每个优化步骤都要构造精确或近似的正交变换。我们用正交性缺陷 ‖AᵀA−I‖₂ 度量变换 A 与正交的偏离程度。对于截断 Cayley-Neumann 级数的 OFTv2，我们证明截断阶数并不能决定该缺陷：在默认阶数下，参考实现检查点中的块缺陷跨越五个数量级。我们提出 ==Restarted Tangent Orthogonal Finetuning（RTOFT）==，它使用权重 W 的一阶更新 W(I+S)（S 为反对称矩阵），仅当漂移 ‖S‖₂ 达到容差 τ 时才通过极分解恢复精确正交性。I+S 的缺陷恰为 ‖S‖₂²，因此每次更新后读取漂移并在下一次前向之前恢复，即可保证每次前向的缺陷至多为 τ²，且与损失、数据、模型和优化器无关。最后一次恢复使返回的变换精确正交。在 GLUE 上，RTOFT 将块对角、子空间和蝶形参数化的训练时间从 LoRA 的 1.10–1.58 倍**降至 0.97–1.13 倍**，其块对角版本在六个任务平均上比 LoRA 高 1.98±0.39 个点（五个随机种子）。在 τ=0.10 时，DeBERTaV3、Qwen 和扩散模型训练中读到的最大漂移保持在 0.10 到 0.12 之间，而每个 epoch 只恢复一次时则在 0.17 到 1.65 之间。在消融的全部七种设置中，不恢复的切线更新都比恢复的更差，而每步都恢复相比按容差恢复没有可测的精度收益，且每步多花 4.5%–27.5%。
papers.abstract_en: Orthogonal finetuning (OFT) adapts a pretrained weight by an orthogonal transform and preserves its singular values and row angles, but existing methods construct an exact or approximate orthogonal transform at every optimization step. We measure how far a transform $A$ is from orthogonal by its orthogonality defect $\|A^\top A-I\|_2$. For OFTv2, which truncates a Cayley-Neumann series, we show that the truncation order does not determine the defect. At its default order, block defects in checkpoints from the reference implementation span five orders of magnitude. We propose Restarted Tangent Orthogonal Finetuning (RTOFT), which uses the first-order update $W(I+S)$ of a weight $W$ with a skew-symmetric $S$ and restores exact orthogonality by a polar decomposition only when the drift $\|S\|_2$ reaches a tolerance $τ$. The defect of $I+S$ is exactly $\|S\|_2^2$. Therefore, reading the drift after every update and restoring before the next forward pass guarantees a defect of at most $τ^2$ in every forward pass, independently of the loss, data, model, and optimizer. A final restoration makes the returned transform exactly orthogonal. On GLUE, RTOFT reduces the training time of block-diagonal, subspace, and butterfly parameterizations from $1.10$-$1.58\times$ to $0.97$-$1.13\times$ that of LoRA, and its block-diagonal version exceeds LoRA by $1.98\pm0.39$ points on the six-task average over five seeds. At $τ=0.10$, the largest drift read during training stays between $0.10$ and $0.12$ across DeBERTaV3, Qwen, and diffusion models, whereas it ranges from $0.17$ to $1.65$ when restoring once per epoch. In all seven settings of our ablation, the tangent update is worse without restoration than with it, and restoring after every step yields no measurable accuracy gain over restoring at the tolerance and costs $4.5$-$27.5\%$ more per step.

papers.title: LogToPersona: New Benchmark and Efficient Persona Prediction through Semantic Log Filtering
papers.title_zh: LogToPersona：新基准与基于语义日志过滤的高效画像预测
papers.summary_zh: 用语义日志过滤缩短输入，降低端侧画像推理的KV Cache内存与预填充时间。
papers.abstract_zh: 了解用户画像对个性化生成式AI模型和智能体很有价值，但这类细节难以获得且会随时间变化。我们研究如何从单日的手机活动日志中推断画像属性。由于缺乏合适的公开基准，我们构建了包含1,600个画像-日志对的合成基准。我们面向端侧推理，使原始日志不离开手机，这使限制因素从速度变成内存：一天的活动约产生30K个token，仅其 key-value cache 就超过4B参数模型INT4权重的大小。为此我们提出一种日志过滤方法，只保留行为上有区分度的条目。在来自四个系列的九个模型上，==过滤==**最多可将内存占用降低39%，并使预填充时间减半以上**，同时保持或提升预测质量。对于Qwen3-4B，它减少了2.5GB，使模型从远超单进程合理预算降到可控范围。在我们的基准内，这些结果表明，对画像预测而言，保留多样的行为事件比保留每一条语义相似的日志更重要。
papers.abstract_en: Detailed knowledge of a user's persona is valuable for personalizing generative AI models and agents, yet such details are difficult to obtain and change over time. We address the task of inferring persona attributes from a single day of mobile activity logs. No suitable publicly available benchmark exists for this task, so we introduce a synthetic benchmark of 1,600 persona-log pairs. We target on-device inference so that raw logs never leave the phone, which makes memory rather than speed the limiting constraint: a day of activity yields roughly 30K tokens, whose key-value cache alone exceeds the INT4 weights of a 4B-parameter model. We therefore propose a log filtering method that retains only behaviorally distinct entries. Filtering reduces the memory footprint by up to 39% across nine models from four families and more than halves prefill time, while maintaining or improving prediction quality. For Qwen3-4B it removes 2.5GB, bringing the model from well beyond a realistic per-process budget to a manageable one. Within our benchmark, these results indicate that preserving diverse behavioral events matters more for persona prediction than retaining every semantically similar log entry.

papers.title: WADJET: Whole-Job Authorization and Dispatch for Job Execution Trust on FPGA System-on-Chip Accelerators
papers.title_zh: WADJET：FPGA片上系统加速器上面向作业执行可信的整作业授权与分发
papers.summary_zh: 在FPGA逻辑中设置整作业校验门，防止软件篡改或重放加速器作业。
papers.abstract_zh: 在FPGA片上系统中，向加速器提交工作的软件同时也决定加速器做什么。它逐个写寄存器，硬件则执行所见内容，因此出错或被攻陷的软件可以改动某个地址或重发作业。现有保护机制决定谁能访问加速器或保护其数据安全。要判断一个作业是否经过批准且尚未使用，需要三件事同在一处：通往加速器的唯一通路、在校验完成前扣住整个作业、以及已用批准的记录。WADJET把这三件事放进FPGA逻辑中的同一个门。独立的授权方使用Ascon-AEAD128，带序列号地加密并认证每个获批作业。该门在放行任何部分之前先校验整个作业，只接受更新的序列号并将其用掉，并自行写入未修改加速器的寄存器。该门只替换处理器通往寄存器的直连通路，并与现有保护机制并行工作。在软件模型中，逐次写入检查会运行由两个获批作业混合而成的作业，而整作业规则一个也没有放行。其放行路径已在Verilog上对所有输入证明。在运行语言模型的Zynq-7020上，它放行了全部21,000个获批作业，而14,700个被篡改或重放的作业一个也未放行。它所需的查找表数量是ShEF寄存器保护的三分之一（后者保护范围更广），并使作业启动增加约十微秒。它假设其密钥、复位和配置处于可信控制之下。
papers.abstract_en: On an FPGA system-on-chip, the software that submits work to an accelerator also decides what the accelerator does. It writes the registers one by one, and the hardware runs whatever it finds, so faulty or compromised software can change one address or resend a job. Existing protections decide who may reach an accelerator or keep its data safe. Deciding whether one job was approved and is still unused takes three things in one place: the only way to the accelerator, the whole job held back until checked, and a record of used approvals. WADJET puts the three in one gate in FPGA logic. A separate authority encrypts and authenticates each approved job, with a sequence number, using Ascon-AEAD128. The gate verifies the whole job before releasing any part, accepts only a newer sequence number, uses it up, and writes the registers of an unmodified accelerator itself. The gate replaces only the processor's direct line to the registers and works beside the existing protections. In a software model, a check on each write ran jobs mixed from two approved ones; the whole-job rule released none. Its release path is proven on the Verilog for all inputs. On a Zynq-7020 running a language model, it released all 21,000 approved jobs and none of 14,700 altered or repeated ones. It needs a third of the lookup tables of ShEF's register protection, which protects more, and adds about ten microseconds to starting a job. It assumes trusted control of its key, reset, and configuration.

papers.title: Understanding Diffusion Acceleration: Methods, Trade-Offs, and Open Questions
papers.title_zh: 理解扩散加速：方法、权衡与开放问题
papers.summary_zh: 用统一记号综述蒸馏、一致性训练、采样与去噪器设计四类扩散加速路线。
papers.abstract_zh: 扩散与基于流的生成模型支持高质量的图像、音频和视频合成。采样可能需要数十到数百次去噪器评估，而随着分辨率、视频长度或模型规模的增加，每次前向都更昂贵。这一成本影响交互式和边缘应用中的延迟与能耗。我们考察四类加速推理的途径：蒸馏、一致性训练、采样方法和去噪器设计。我们用统一的记号表述训练目标、转移映射和数值更新，以比较它们对学习目标、采样轨迹以及每次去噪前向内部工作量的改变。已发表的图像与视频基准结果展示了一步和少步生成的质量–成本权衡、求解器与时间步调度之间的相互作用、特征缓存的效果，以及首帧延迟与持续流式吞吐之间的差异。最后我们讨论了开放问题：视觉原生架构与压缩后蒸馏、求解器感知的少步训练，以及基于因子化分布匹配的语义轨迹对齐。
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion and flow-based generative models support high-quality image, audio, and video synthesis. Sampling can require dozens to hundreds of denoiser evaluations, with each pass becoming more expensive as resolution, video length, or model size increases. This cost affects latency and energy use in interactive and edge applications. We examine four approaches to accelerating inference: distillation, consistency training, sampling methods, and denoiser design. We express training objectives, transition maps, and numerical updates in a common notation to compare changes to the learning target, the sampling trajectory, and the work performed within each denoiser pass. Published image and video benchmarks illustrate the quality--cost trade-offs of one- and few-step generation, the interaction between solvers and timestep schedules, the effect of feature caching, and the difference between first-frame latency and sustained streaming throughput. We close with open problems in visual-native architectures and post-compression distillation, solver-aware few-step training, and semantic trajectory alignment with factorized distribution matching.

papers.title: Focus Only on What's Important: Training-Free Focus Maps for Frozen Vision Transformers in Long-Video Object Segmentation
papers.title_zh: 只关注重点：面向长视频目标分割的冻结视觉Transformer免训练聚焦图
papers.summary_zh: 用免训练聚焦图在长视频分割中减少冻结ViT编码器计算量
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉Transformer是强大的视频目标分割图像编码器，但开销很大。免训练的token合并在整帧上均匀削减计算，包括被跟踪的物体区域。我们为训练好的Cutie分割头内的冻结DINOv3 ViT提供一种免训练==聚焦图==：分割器预期有物体的位置保持全分辨率，其余位置采用更粗的合并。只保护上一帧掩码的做法在短片段上有效，但在长视频中会失败，因为快速运动会把目标推出保护边界而落入背景合并，造成不可恢复的损失。我们的策略改为取速度平移掩码与块匹配掩码的并集，运行经相机补偿的惊奇度检查，把不确定区域交给对比的合并器处理，并在所有物体丢失时回退到该合并器。在长视频（LVOS V2 valid，预先设定的协议，三个ViT-S随机种子）上，它比ALGM 0.98高出**+2.76 J&F**（95%物体置信区间[+1.22,+4.44]；视频聚类[+0.99,+4.52]），编码器计数FLOPs减少16%（0.385对0.459），比稠密编码器基线低1.0个J&F点；在ViT-B上相对ALGM 0.95的增益为+3.89 [+2.03,+5.87]。在DAVIS 2017 val上，ViT-S与稠密编码器相差不超过-0.19 J&F（ViT-B为-0.12）。对照实验限定了结论：在ALGM下只保护上一帧掩码，精度持平或更高，但FLOPs更高（0.486），因此预期与惊奇机制主要降低的是计数的编码器计算量。实际上，计数编码器计算量的降低并未减少包含启动时间的Cutie平均步耗时（在12个LVOS视频样本上，稳态下低3%-8%；经同等工程优化的ALGM在ViT-S和ViT-B上更快）。第5.2节另行考察了Cutie永久记忆调度及其延迟与内存的权衡。代码：https://github.com/boletoms/focused-cv
papers.abstract_en: Vision transformers are strong but costly image encoders for video object segmentation. Training-free token merging cuts compute uniformly across the frame, including on tracked objects. We give a frozen DINOv3 ViT inside a trained Cutie head a training-free focus map: full resolution where the segmenter expects its objects and coarser merging elsewhere. Protecting only the previous frame's mask works on short clips but fails on long videos, where fast motion pushes targets outside the margin and into background merging, locking in loss. Our policy instead takes the union of velocity-shifted and block-matched masks, runs a camera-compensated surprise check, delegates uncertain regions to the compared merger, and falls back to it when all objects are lost. On long videos (LVOS V2 valid, pre-specified protocol, three ViT-S seeds), it beats ALGM 0.98 by +2.76 J&F (95% object CI [+1.22,+4.44]; video-cluster [+0.99,+4.52]) at 16% fewer counted encoder FLOPs (0.385 vs. 0.459), sitting 1.0 J&F point below the dense-encoder baseline; at ViT-B the gain over ALGM 0.95 is +3.89 [+2.03,+5.87]. On DAVIS 2017 val it stays within -0.19 J&F of the dense encoder at ViT-S (-0.12 at ViT-B). Controls qualify the result: protecting only the previous mask under ALGM matches or exceeds accuracy at higher FLOPs (0.486), so expectation and surprise mainly reduce counted encoder compute. Practically, lower counted encoder compute did not reduce startup-inclusive mean Cutie step time on a 12-video LVOS sample (3%-8% lower in steady state; an equally engineered ALGM is faster at ViT-S and ViT-B). Section 5.2 separately examines a Cutie permanent-memory schedule and its latency and memory trade-offs. Code: https://github.com/boletoms/focused-cv

papers.title: Not Every Input Needs Everything: Unifying Expert Gating, Model Cascades, and Agent Orchestration
papers.title_zh: 并非每个输入都需要全部：统一专家门控、模型级联与智能体编排
papers.summary_zh: 系统综述2,289项研究，用“先检查后分配”框架统一专家门控、模型级联与智能体编排。
papers.abstract_zh: 对每个输入都统一执行庞大的神经网络权重、前沿基础模型或整个多智能体工作流，会带来可观的计算、延迟和费用开销。条件计算通过按请求动态决定调用哪些内部专家、模型端点或专门智能体来缓解这一成本。然而，稀疏神经架构中的token级门控、查询级的模型级联以及任务级的多智能体协调，基本上各自在孤立的研究圈子中发展，掩盖了反复出现的系统性失败及可迁移的修复方法。在这篇系统综述中，我们在统一的==先检查后分配==两步框架下，综合了2017年至2026年9月间发表的2,289项研究（从13,884条唯一记录中筛选），涵盖20个方法族。离散硬选择在token级、查询级和任务级文献中分别占70%、83%和91%，而计算开销在每一层都是首要的运行瓶颈。工程保障措施极不对称：层内门控优先考虑负载均衡，却很少引入不确定性估计；而模型选择与智能体编排依赖置信度阈值和预算规则，同时面临校准失准和级联错误。与此同时，**智能体任务委派的发表量增长最快，其路由机制却最少被单独做实验验证，方法偏倚风险最高**。
papers.abstract_en: Executing monolithic neural weights, frontier foundation models, or entire multi-agent workflows uniformly on every input incurs substantial computational, latency, and monetary overhead. Conditional computation mitigates this cost by deciding dynamically which internal experts, model endpoints, or specialized agents to invoke per request. Yet token-level gating in sparse neural architectures, query-level model cascades, and task-level multi-agent coordination have largely progressed in disconnected research silos, obscuring recurring system failures and transferable fixes. In this systematic review, we synthesize 2,289 studies published between 2017 and September 2026 (selected from 13,884 unique records) across 20 methodological families under a unified two-step inspect-then-allocate framework. Discrete hard selection accounts for 70%, 83%, and 91% of token-, query-, and task-scale literature respectively, and computational overhead appears as a top operational bottleneck across every layer. Engineering safeguards remain sharply asymmetric: intra-layer gating prioritizes load balancing while rarely incorporating uncertainty estimation, whereas model selection and agent orchestration rely on confidence thresholds and budget rules while confronting miscalibration and cascading errors. At the same time, publication volume is accelerating fastest in agentic task delegation, where routing mechanisms are least often isolated experimentally and methodological bias risk is highest.

papers.title: Scalpel and Brush: Pruning and Targeted Weight Editing of a Small Language Model by a Single LLM Agent
papers.title_zh: 手术刀与画笔：由单个LLM智能体对小型语言模型做剪枝与定向权重编辑
papers.summary_zh: 让LLM智能体对小模型做稀疏权重编辑与神经元剪枝，并与随机编辑和标准方法对比。
papers.abstract_zh: 近期研究表明LLM可以自己编辑语言模型的权重，但尚不清楚这类结果中有多少归功于智能体本身，有多少可由同形状的随机编辑、提示中的指令或不用LLM的标准流程复现。我们把修复和剪枝统一为针对我们指定指标（以BLEU为例）的稀疏权重编辑：定向权重修复（“画笔”）、结构化MLP神经元剪枝（“手术刀”，将被剪权重置零）以及带修复的层移除，这三项任务交给由DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash驱动的DeepSeek Harness智能体，最多进行50次开发集评估。我们在Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct上对每个任务做三次独立运行，并在两个隐藏划分上做最终评估。在常微分方程任务上，至多改动0.0084%的权重，就使二阶方程的测试BLEU提高24-32%，使多项式右端项方程提高1.8-2.5倍。独立的替换检验显示，更高的BLEU反映的是符号表示对齐，而非正确性提升。移除12.5-15%的MLP神经元的掩码使模型缩小9.4-11.2%，在两个隐藏划分上平均BLEU损失至多0.01，而每层等比例的标准剪枝在所有测试比例下都未满足约束。在七类GoEmotions分类上，编辑使宏平均F1在测试集上从0.100升至0.396-0.451，在留出集上从0.175升至0.455-0.476。将基于岭回归的分类器写入智能体选定的权重行，宏平均F1为0.424和0.464。在相同评估次数限制下，剪枝搜索移除15.9%的神经元，而通过隐藏检验的智能体运行为14-21.4%。一旦给定智能体找到的干预位置与形式，不使用LLM的标准流程就能复现大部分性能；智能体搜索与非智能体搜索的比较仍是开放问题。
papers.abstract_en: It has recently been shown that an LLM can itself edit the weights of a language model, yet it remains unclear which part of such a result is due to the agent and which part is reproduced by a random edit of the same shape, by an instruction in the prompt, or by a standard procedure without an LLM. We unify repair and pruning as sparse weight edits to optimize a metric we specify, using BLEU as an example: three tasks -- targeted weight repair ("brush"), structured MLP neuron pruning ("scalpel", zeroing pruned weights), and layer removal with repair - are assigned to a DeepSeek Harness agent powered by DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, with up to 50 dev evaluations. We study Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct in three independent runs per task, with final evaluation on two hidden splits. On ordinary differential equations, changing at most 0.0084% of weights raised test BLEU by 24-32% on second-order equations and by a factor of 1.8-2.5 on equations with polynomial right-hand sides. An independent substitution check showed that higher BLEU reflects notation alignment rather than improved correctness. Masks that remove 12.5-15% of MLP neurons shrink the model by 9.4-11.2% with mean BLEU loss of at most 0.01 on both hidden splits, whereas standard pruning with equal shares per layer failed the constraint at all tested shares. On seven-class GoEmotions classification, edits raise macro-F1 from 0.100 to 0.396-0.451 on test and from 0.175 to 0.455-0.476 on holdout. A ridge-based classifier written into agent-selected weight rows yields macro-F1 of 0.424 and 0.464. Pruning search with the same evaluation limit removes 15.9% of neurons versus 14-21.4% for agent runs passing the hidden check. Standard procedures without an LLM reproduce much of the performance once given the location and form of intervention found by the agent; a comparison of agentic and non-agentic search remains open.

papers.title: Sparse Adaptation for In-Context Learning on Data Streams
papers.title_zh: 面向数据流上上下文学习的稀疏适配
papers.summary_zh: 提出SAIL，在表格基础模型的数据流适配中复用KV Cache，仅在漂移时重建上下文。
papers.abstract_zh: 物联网产生海量数据流，使边缘计算对低延迟应用和5G网络至关重要。表格基础模型（TFM）通过上下文示例而非参数更新来实现适配，但不断演化的数据流对上下文相关性和计算效率提出了挑战。本文提出SAIL，一个面向TFM的稀疏适配框架，在两次适配事件之间==复用模型的 key-value cache==。SAIL仅在数据流结构的漂移表明上下文可能不再适用时才重建其支持集，而结构表示本身则随预测性能的变化而更新。SAIL将前序误差监控与在线的、分类别的微聚类结合起来，以检测簇质量、类别可分性和特征空间覆盖率的变化。适配时，按类别质量比例分配上下文预算，并由最近更新的微聚类提供有代表性的观测用于重新拟合。这限制了上下文冗余和计算成本，同时保留了近期的结构信息。
papers.abstract_en: The Internet of Things (IoT) generates massive data streams, making edge computing essential for low-latency applications and 5G networks. Tabular foundation models (TFMs) enable adaptation through in-context examples rather than parameter updates, but evolving streams challenge context relevance and computational efficiency. This work introduces SAIL, a framework for sparse adaptation of TFMs that reuses the model's key--value cache between adaptation events. SAIL reconstructs its support set only when drifts in stream structure indicate potential context inadequacy, while the structural representation itself is updated by changes in predictive performance. SAIL combines prequential error monitoring with online, class-specific micro-clustering to detect changes in cluster mass, class separability, and feature-space coverage. Upon adaptation, a context budget is allocated proportionally to class mass, and the most recently updated micro-clusters provide representative observations for refitting. This limits context redundancy and computational cost while preserving recent structural information.

papers.title: A Calibration-Referenced Protocol for Measuring Decision Stability under Reference Bank Compression
papers.title_zh: 降低参考库压缩下决策稳定性的校准参照度量协议
papers.summary_zh: 提出度量参考库压缩（含乘积量化与 int8）对异常判定影响的协议。
papers.abstract_zh: 工业图像检测所用的参考库可以被压缩以满足部署预算，但压缩后的异常判定同时取决于压缩后的分数和操作阈值。我们提出一个四步协议：在匹配的部署规模下比较压缩方法；从 200 次重新校准中建立参考分布；对照两个校准基准评估判定的不一致性；并按距完整库阈值的距离度量变化。使用 WideResNet-50 时，在 VisA 和 MVTec AD 上、两个操作水平下，预算匹配的乘积量化（PQ）在 10% 预算处的判定不一致性最低，对比的五种匹配方法包括 int8 标量量化。在其余四个预算下，int8 标量量化的不一致性低于 PQ。在 MVTec AD 的较低操作水平上，PQ 在 34/39 个单元中达到校准中位数，在 39/39 个单元中达到上分位数。该预算下按类别等权平均的图像级 AUROC 损失在各评估配置中为 0.0003 到 0.0037。在 VisA 上，1% 预算、1% 操作水平下，近阈值异常样本的不一致率达到 28.12%（95% CI 23.25–33.58%），正常留出集上为 1.30%（0.79–2.14%）。使用 ResNet-18、干净的参考库，以及从正常目录探针估计阈值时，10% 预算匹配的 PQ 设置在四种对比方法中仍保持最低的不一致性。该协议把部署规模与以校准为参照的判定度量联系起来，并指出了对检测最有信息量的评估样本群体。
papers.abstract_en: Reference banks used for industrial image inspection can be compressed to fit a deployment budget, but the resulting anomaly decisions depend on both the compressed scores and the operating threshold. We present a four-step protocol that compares compression methods at matched deployment sizes, establishes a reference distribution from 200 recalibrations, evaluates disagreement against two calibration benchmarks, and measures changes by distance from the full-bank threshold. With WideResNet-50, budget-matched product quantization (PQ) at the 10% budget has the lowest decision disagreement among five matched methods, including int8 scalar quantization, on VisA and MVTec AD at both operating levels. Int8 scalar quantization gives lower disagreement than PQ at the other four budgets. On MVTec AD at the lower operating level, PQ meets the calibration median in 34/39 cells and the upper quantile in 39/39 cells. Category-equally weighted image-level AUROC loss at this budget ranges from 0.0003 to 0.0037 across the evaluated configurations. On VisA at the 1% budget and a 1% operating level, disagreement reaches 28.12% (95% CI 23.25--33.58%) among near-threshold anomalies and 1.30% (0.79--2.14%) across the normal holdout. The 10% budget-matched PQ setting retains the lowest disagreement among four compared methods with ResNet-18, with clean reference banks, and when thresholds are estimated from normal-directory probes. The protocol connects deployment size to a calibration-referenced decision measure and identifies the evaluation populations most informative for inspection.

papers.title: Routeability Before Routing: Routeability Audit Protocol (RAP) and RouteabilityBench for Audited LLM Model Selection
papers.title_zh: 路由之前先看可路由性：面向可审计LLM模型选择的可路由性审计协议RAP与RouteabilityBench
papers.summary_zh: 提出审计基准是否适合评估LLM路由的协议与基准
papers.abstract_zh: LLM路由旨在为每个提示选择模型组合中最可能答对的那个模型。只有当基准包含足够多针对具体提示的差异、使不同模型在不同输入上各擅胜场时，路由才有意义。然而在粗粒度打分的LLM基准上，许多模型常常并列最优，单个最佳模型可能已几乎没有提升空间。为此我们提出==可路由性优先的审计==，具体实现为RAP与RouteabilityBench，一个可运行的主张验证包。该审计是回溯式的：在基准—模型组合的得分矩阵已经存在、且在把路由器比较当作一般性证据之前运行，而不是为尚未评估的模型组合做认证。在四个基准和66个LLM上，更大的嵌入集合、降维、选择性弃权、聚类和更强的回归器等通用路由增强手段，**并未稳定地优于单个最佳模型**。最明确的正面证据集中在依赖模型组合的Omni-MATH设定，而GPQA、MMLU-Pro和IFEval则分别展示了路由仍然困难或对预测器敏感的不同情形。我们的实践建议是，报告路由收益时应同时给出可路由性诊断、并列最优分析、模型组合构建细节以及按家族校正的统计检验。
papers.abstract_en: LLM routing aims to choose, for each prompt, which model in a portfolio is most likely to answer correctly. This only makes sense when the benchmark contains enough prompt-specific variation for different models to be best on different inputs. On coarse-scored LLM benchmarks, however, many models often tie for the best score, and the single best model may already leave little room for improvement. We therefore propose a routeability-first audit, instantiated as RAP and RouteabilityBench, a runnable claim-verification package. The audit is retrospective: it runs once the benchmark-portfolio score matrix exists and before router comparisons are interpreted as general evidence, rather than certifying a portfolio that has not yet been evaluated. Across four benchmarks and 66 LLMs, generic routing enhancements such as larger embedding sets, dimensionality reduction, selective abstention, clustering, and stronger regressors do not consistently outperform the single best model. The clearest positive evidence is concentrated in portfolio-dependent Omni-MATH settings, while GPQA, MMLU-Pro, and IFEval show different ways in which routing can remain hard or predictor-sensitive. Our practical recommendation is that routing gains should be reported together with routeability diagnostics, tied-best analysis, portfolio construction details, and family-corrected statistical tests.
